title: Director of Enterprise Account Management
jd: ABOUT PEARL Pearl is the leading AI-powered clinical operations platform for dental service organizations and practices, helping dentists work smarter, improve outcomes, and run more profitable practices by streamlining clinical workflows, enhancing diagnostics, and optimizing operations across hundreds of locations. THE ROLE We're seeking an Account Management Lead to build and lead Pearl's Enterprise Account Management function from the ground up. You're a sales leader first and organizational builder — focused on accelerating Live ARR across your portfolio and your team's accounts — while creating a scalable function that becomes the backbone of enterprise customer success at Pearl. You'll bring a proven playbook and vision for how to scale account management across our growing DSO customer base. You'll own the commercial relationship for 3–5 strategic dental practice groups (75–499+ locations) while establishing best practices, building systems and processes, and developing a team of 3–5 Account Managers that oversees both mid-market (20–74 locations) and enterprise (75+ locations). KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Team Leadership - Build the Account Management function from the ground up — define role clarity, hiring profiles, compensation philosophy, and team structure - Establish account management processes, playbooks, methodologies, and templates that scale across the team; define how we approach QBRs, account planning, expansion strategy, and customer engagement - Hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of 3–5 Account Managers; set expectations, manage performance, and coach toward excellence - Create and own team KPIs (revenue, retention, expansion, forecast accuracy, pipeline discipline); establish accountability standards and report up through the Go To Market Organization Commercial Ownership & Revenue Growth - Own accounts from the point of a net-new customer's full estate commitment or an existing customer's expansion, and take responsibility for identifying growth opportunities, account health, and product adoption. - Own 3–5 assigned Enterprise accounts as primary contact for customer leadership; own individual expansion ARR and retention targets - Own the team's collective revenue performance and forecast; support Account Managers with complex closures and escalations - Drive POC conversion, quantify expansion opportunities, manage renewals, and maintain accurate pipeline and 12-month account plans - Proactively identify at-risk relationships and develop retention strategies Customer Engagement & Execution - Lead QBRs/EBRs for assigned accounts; prepare metrics-driven reviews demonstrating ROI and readiness for expansion - Build account growth plans with clear milestones, success metrics, and risk identification - Guide team through QBR preparation and execution; facilitate strategic planning sessions with key accounts - Manage implementation timelines and success plans; coordinate with Onboarding, Product, and Analytics on customer priorities Function & Cross-Functional Leadership - Design and implement Account Management function strategy, operating model, and tooling — bring your proven approach and recommend improvements to CRM, forecasting, pipeline discipline, and customer communication cadence - Partner with Enterprise Sales, Solutions Consulting, and Operations to align on account strategy, go-to-market approach, and team structure - Define how Account Management operates with Product, Engineering, Onboarding, and Analytics; establish escalation protocols and cross-functional workflows that scale - Lead forecasting, pipeline reviews, quarterly business planning, and executive reporting; set the standard for team CRM discipline and customer file accuracy WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO SUCCEED - 7+ years in enterprise account management, sales, or revenue growth, including 3+ years building or scaling a SaaS Account Management function — or establishing the playbook for one in a high-growth environment - Proven track record of expanding existing accounts and driving revenue growth at scale, including POC conversions and complex sales-cycle closures, within large, multi-location customer relationships - Demonstrated ability to build and articulate a repeatable account management playbook, backed by strong SaaS metrics/ROI modeling acumen and stakeholder management across C-suite and cross-functional teams - Track record of mentoring and developing sales professionals as a self-directed leader who manages multiple accounts, direct reports, and competing priorities with strong organizational discipline and follow-through - Demonstrated AI curiosity and a builder's mindset — quick to adopt AI/LLM tools and automation to eliminate manual workflows and create scalable systems, rather than waiting for the perfect process to be handed to you - Healthcare or SaaS experience preferred; willingness to travel up to 40% NICE TO HAVE - Experience building Account Management functions or departments at 0→1 or high-growth companies - Multi-location or DSO operations background - Healthcare technology or dental software experience - Consultative selling and HubSpot CRM experience - Startup or high-growth company experience - Remote or geographically dispersed team management experience WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive compensation and benefits - Professional development and training opportunities - Flexible, uncapped PTO - Stock options - Remote work environment

title: Founding Product Manager - freeflow
jd: ABOUT FREEFLOW Freeflow is building AI Agents for P&C Insurance Carriers. We’re starting by solving a customer problem that has strong pull from our industry contacts: Claims auditing. Today, carriers audit a small percentage of claims. They do these audits manually, inconsistently, and often too late to drive meaningful outcomes on key business metrics like Loss Ratio, Customer Satisfaction, or Claims Capacity. We believe the future is: → Continuous, AI-driven audits across 100% of claims → Real-time detection of leakage, errors, and missed opportunities → Direct, measurable improvement to the loss ratio But claims audits are just the starting point. Our broader vision is to build an AI-native operating layer for insurance carriers, that includes: - Submission intake: structuring and routing risk data at the quote stage - Premium audits: ensuring accuracy between exposure and written premium at the bind stage - Claims audits: real-time detection of leakage, errors, and missed opportunities at the claim stage Having even two out of the three nodes allows Freeflow to create an intelligent data layer powered by AI agents that continuously improves decision-making across the carrier’s operations. This is how we move the loss ratio at scale. AS A FOUNDING PRODUCT MANAGER AT FREEFLOW YOU WILL - You will work directly with founders, customers, and engineers to define what we build, why we build it, and how it creates real economic value (eg improving loss ratios, replacing offshore teams, improving capacity, etc) - This is a 0→1 role where you will define how AI agents: - Understand the world of insurance through modeling industry ontologies - Understand and integrate with our various carrier customers’ systems and SOPs - Review specific data structures (claims files, policies, submissions) - Generate actionable intelligence based on core data to create both efficiency gains and learning opportunities for our carrier customers - Work directly with carriers - Engage claims leaders, audit teams, and executives - Translate real-world pain into shipped product quickly ABOUT YOU - Technical - Leverage yourself and the product org with AI - Interviewing users, SMEs and documenting + transmitting learnings across org - Modeling requirements - Prioritizing efforts in alignment with business strategy - Managing backlogs, feature prioritization - Close collaboration with product design - Given the carrier customers (SOC2, RBAC, SSO, data partitioning), understand enterprise security and compliance requirements. - Collaborate on product strategy, roadmap prioritization, and go-to-market decisions. - Partner directly with engineers to break down product requirements into actionable specs. You'll own the "what" and "why," collaborate on the "how," and be close enough to implementation details to unblock decisions quickly. - Cultural - Passionate about solving customer needs and love moving fast. You are excited about the opportunity to be the primary AI/agent specialist on a small, high-ownership engineering team - You can demonstrate experience with solving open-ended problems in startups at the earliest stage (0 to 1) and you are - able to independently identify critical problems to deliver on key customer needs, propose and implement solutions to those problems - able to structure and execute your own work with little to no supervision BONUS - Deep experience in P&C insurance claims or claims auditing - Comfort working large unstructured data files (documents, notes, images, video, audio, tasks) Note, we don’t expect you to know everything listed above. What matters most to us is that you are experienced, enjoy solving hard problems independently, are passionate about building new AI technology, are an outstanding team player, and you are interested in learning and growing on the job professionally and personally. If you’re excited about building AI systems that start with claims audits, but expand into a broader platform that transforms how insurance carriers operate: We should talk. WHAT WE OFFER - Role - Being part of a mission-driven company reimagining how humans interact with technology. - A well defined culture https://www.notion.so/Culture-2045799bf2878063bea9c31667aa75a1?pvs=21 that values autonomy, experimentation, growth and high impact results. - Benefits - Competitive compensation, stock options, health insurance - Flexible PTO - AI tooling + add-ons of your choice to maximize your productivity

title: Senior Implementation Manager
jd: COMPANY OVERVIEW Founded in 2015, PHIL is a Series D health-tech startup that is building a platform that interfaces between doctors, pharmacies, and patients to streamline the process of patients receiving prescriptions. This is a complex, archaic industry, and we've set out to change that. PHIL’s B2B2C platform provides an end-to-end prescription management and delivery service. Our robust platform connects patients, prescribers, pharmacies, and manufacturers, enabling easy and affordable access to medicine. Through its digital stakeholder experiences, patient access services, market access solutions, and distribution models, pharma manufacturers can deliver affordable and timely therapy access to patients, resulting in more patients staying on their treatment plans longer. Consequently, pharma manufacturers are enabled for more innovation. The team at PHIL is a group of like-minded individuals from varying backgrounds, passionate about creating a new and innovative healthcare platform that is focused on patient experience and overall human wellbeing. Ready to join our team of mission-driven, analytical, and passionate people? Keep reading! Position Overview PHIL is seeking a talented and experienced Senior Implementation Manager, Professional Services to lead enterprise client implementations from committed intent through program activation. This role will focus on solution design, cross-functional execution, and delivering high-quality, technically sound implementations that drive speed to value. Reporting to the Director of Professional Services, you will own end-to-end implementation strategy, translate client goals into technical solution architecture, and ensure operational readiness across product, engineering, operations, and client stakeholders. This is a highly visible, client-facing role that requires strong ownership, technical fluency, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own full-cycle implementation delivery from kickoff through activation, ensuring alignment between contractual scope, client goals, and technical solution design - Lead discovery and current state assessments, translating client objectives into detailed technical specifications and operational protocols - Design and document complete program architecture, including configuration standards, business logic, operating rules, and adoption pathways - Create and maintain a centralized source of truth outlining solution design, workflows, and reporting structures - Drive cross-functional execution across product, engineering, operations, sales, and client success to ensure on-time delivery and operational readiness - Monitor and report on implementation health, including status updates, risk tracking, and priority dashboards - Serve as a product subject matter expert, understanding PHIL’s platform capabilities, roadmap, integrations, and data workflows - Oversee logging and follow-through on technical requests, ensuring tickets are properly grouped, tracked, and aligned to broader initiatives - Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, and efficiency gains in delivery methodology - Influence internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex issues while maintaining scope integrity and project momentum QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience - 10+ years of technology-enabled services implementation experience - 5+ years of vendor-side ownership of enterprise implementations - 5+ years managing cross-functional and project-specific teams in a matrixed environment - Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into technical architecture and operational execution - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to decision making - Technical fluency in enterprise integrations including APIs, SFTP, flat file transfers, and SQL - Familiarity with AI and LLM applications within technology-enabled service environments - Experience designing implementation processes, documentation standards, and scalable delivery frameworks - Proven ability to influence stakeholders and negotiate solutions across diverse internal and external constituencies - Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences - Ability to travel up to 25% BENEFITS - Ground floor opportunity with one of the fastest-growing startups in health-tech - Fully remote working environment available in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, MA, MI, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV - Competitive compensation (commensurate with experience) - Full benefits (medical, dental, vision) - 401(k) contribution opportunity PHIL Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Senior Product Manager - Launch and Client Success
jd: SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER, LAUNCH AND CLIENT SUCCESS ABOUT PHIL Getting a prescription filled shouldn't be the hardest part of starting treatment. Yet for many patients, it is. PHIL is a Series D health-tech company building the platform that connects patients, prescribers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical manufacturers so patients can get their medication quickly and affordably. Our digital hub and pharmacy platform handles everything from enrollment and benefits verification to prior authorization, copay support, and home delivery. For manufacturers, that means more patients start therapy and stay on it, plus the commercial insight to keep improving access. We're a dedicated team of people from a wide range of backgrounds, united by a focus on the patient experience. THE ROLE We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Launch and Client Success to own the successful launch of new manufacturer and provider clients onto PHIL's platform, and to keep those clients succeeding after go-live. This is a hands-on implementation and product role, not a pure roadmap role or an account management role. Launch demand rises and falls, so you'll run new client implementations end to end when volume is high and take on PHIL's product roadmap when it eases. We're growing quickly, and making every launch faster than the last is how we scale without scaling headcount at the same rate. You'll report to the Senior Director of Product Management, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Client Success, and Commercial teams. You'll lead client discovery and the launch plan, while Engineering and Design support on scoping, build, and experience decisions. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Client launches: Lead discovery, solutioning, and launch planning for new manufacturer and provider partners, from kickoff through on-time go-live. - Patient and provider experience decisions: Guide clients through the B2B2C choices that shape their end-consumer experience, advising on what will and won't work well for patients and providers. - Configuration and delivery: Build and test client configuration hands-on, and partner with Engineering to scope, sequence, and ship client-specific changes. - Roadmap work: Own product roadmap initiatives alongside launch commitments, using data to improve adoption, engagement, and value for manufacturers and providers. - Program performance and launch efficiency: Set targets for adoption, retention, and value delivered, drive improvements to client program performance, and use automation and AI to make each launch faster than the last. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR - By 90 days: You've learned the platform, configuration model, and launch process, and have met and demonstrated competency to your key client(s) and internal stakeholders. You've shadowed or co-led a launch and are running discovery and configuration on a live implementation. You've also identified at least one inefficiency in the launch process and proposed automating it with an LLM or agent, including an estimate of the time it would save. - By 6 months: You've led at least one client launch end to end on your own, with a documented plan, risks surfaced early, and go-live on the agreed date. You've shipped at least one roadmap item with defined success metrics, and introduced one automation or AI-driven improvement to the launch process. You're proactively identifying optimizations for launched clients that improve outcomes for patients, clients, and PHIL. Internal stakeholders and leaders trust you to run launches without close oversight. - By 12 months: You've launched multiple clients on time and correctly configured, with measurably shorter launch cycles than when you started. Your clients are hitting the performance targets you set with them, and you've delivered a roadmap improvement with quantified business impact. You've freed up a majority of your own time, and you're using it to build new capabilities that expand PHIL's TAM. WHAT YOU'LL BRING Our strongest candidates have worked on both sides of a client implementation: guiding a partner through decisions and then getting hands dirty to configure, test, and ship the result. They're equally comfortable in a discovery call with a client and a scoping session with engineers, and they know how to keep multiple stakeholders moving together. - 6+ years of experience in product management, solutions architecture, or a similar client-facing product role, ideally in a technology-driven environment - Recent, hands-on experience owning client or partner implementations from discovery through go-live - Experience advising clients on decisions that shape a consumer-facing experience, with a working knowledge of B2B and B2C product principles - Comfort working directly with engineering to scope technical work and make implementation tradeoffs, including file specifications and APIs at the level needed to configure and test - A track record of moving product or launch metrics, with results you can quantify - Hands-on experience using AI or automation tools to scale your own work - You break down ambiguous work, document clearly, and flex between deep implementation work and standard product management as demand shifts - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience NICE TO HAVE - Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another complex, regulated domain - Familiarity with patient services, hub programs, or pharmacy workflows WHY PHIL - Fully remote working environment available in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, MA, MI, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV - Competitive compensation (commensurate with experience) - Full benefits (medical, dental, vision) - 401(k) contribution opportunity - Paid Parental Leave PHIL is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Jr. Enterprise Solutions Engineer
jd: Jr. Enterprise Solutions Engineers are part problem solvers and part architect, developing expertise across solution, product, data, and audience. They operate in close partnership with our sales, client partners, solutions strategy, product, and delivery teams to help translate client business goals into a scalable technical vision, with a particular emphasis on data. They focus on creating value for businesses by helping to uncover root-cause pain points and technical blockers, supporting the design of scalable data and mar-tech solutions that solve for measurable ROI. This is an early-career role built for growth. You'll work alongside expert and principal solutions engineers, owning a real and expanding set of responsibilities from day one while learning the craft of enterprise solutions engineering. What You'll Own From the start, you'll be directly responsible for: Collaborating with expert and principal solutions engineers to uncover technical and business requirements for clients, analyzing challenges, and translating them into effective solutions. Responsibilities include capturing and synthesizing discovery notes, requirements, and client inputs into clear, usable documentation for the broader solutions team. Producing first-draft materials for RFPs/RFIs, client presentations, and solution narratives. Building demos and proof points that showcase Acxiom's capabilities and bring solutions to life. Conducting client, competitive, and market research to inform solution design and positioning. Maintaining solution documentation and keeping deal and solution artifacts organized and current. Applying AI tools to accelerate your research, content creation, and day-to-day workflows, and sharing what works with the team. What You'll Learn With guidance from senior solutions engineers, you'll develop the expertise that defines the role: Acxiom's data and identity offerings: Build deep fluency in our audiences, data products, identity resolution, and clean-room capabilities, and learn to map the right solutions to client use cases. Capability and capacity assessment: Learn to determine whether Acxiom has the data and identity capability to solve a given client challenge. Enterprise discovery: Learn to run and facilitate discovery sessions, diagnose root-cause pain points, and gather business and technical requirements that align cross-functional teams before a solution is presented. Solution design: Learn to translate client challenges into scalable, best-practice-aligned data and mar-tech solutions that fit Acxiom and partner capabilities. Technical storytelling: Learn to translate complex technical concepts into clear, outcome-based narratives and to tailor messaging to different stakeholder levels. Applied AI in solutions engineering: Build practical fluency in applying AI tools to discovery, solution design, and deliverable creation, and stay current on emerging AI capabilities relevant to data, mar-tech, and identity. What You Bring Bachelor's degree with 2+ years' experience in Martech, Adtech, or a data-focused role (e.g., data analyst, data engineer, sales engineer, or similar). Any reference to years of experience should be disregarded in the UK. Foundational understanding of data concepts such as data pipelines, customer data platforms, identity resolution, or analytics. Comfort with AI tools and a demonstrated interest in applying them to everyday work. Understanding of pre-sales mechanics and how deal strategy, pricing inputs, and the RFP/RFI process work on new logo and up-sell opportunities. Strong problem-solving instincts and the ability to grasp complex challenges and weigh feasibility, risk, and value. Clear communication and the ability to explain complex concepts in simple, outcome-focused terms. A collaborative, transparent working style that builds trust across sales, account management, delivery, and strategic advisory teams. A growth mindset and genuine curiosity about emerging trends in data, mar-tech, AI, identity, and privacy. Ownership and accountability: you make timely, objective decisions within scope and take responsibility for your work and results. title: On-site Enterprise Program Coordinator
jd: Job Description The Enterprise Program Coordinator (EPC) is a key role in delivering Agilent Enterprise Solutions to our customers. They are the primary day-to-day operational contact with the customer for all of their program needs. The EPCs objective is to deliver a consistently differentiated customer experience and ensure operational excellence for programs/projects assigned to them. The EPC coordinates all scheduled and reactive/unplanned services for the customer, working with internal and external partners in the process. They ensure that customer inquiries are directed to the appropriate parties internally/externally, and addressed in a timely manner. EPCs regularly work with cross-functional teams to define customer challenges, develop solutions, and implement them in daily operations. Onsite Enterprise Program Coordinators will be integrated directly into the customer day-to-day operations and become part of the onsite team. They will provide additional value by being physically present and execute a broad range of customized duties defined in customer program agreements. title: Staff Deployment Strategist
jd: Alation is pioneering the next era of data intelligence — powered by AI agents and trusted data . Organizations around the world rely on Alation to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding – valued at over $1.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100. As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed. Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence . We move fast, think big, and deliver results together. Job Description: Drive high-impact deployments at the intersection of data intelligence, AI, and governance, with deep grounding in the regulatory and operational realities of complex, regulated industries. As a Deployment Strategist, you act as a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, translating complex governance and business challenges into a clear path toward measurable Alation adoption and value. You bring expertise in the data space — data governance, data catalog, and/or governed AI concepts — along with knowledge of the broader data ecosystem. Strong industry acumen across target verticals (Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and/or Hospitality and Travel) is essential, with the ability to speak to the governance, compliance, and data quality challenges specific to each. What You’ll Do Diagnose data and AI governance gaps specific to regulated, high-complexity industries and translate them into Alation-backed solutions. Serve as a credible advisor on industry-specific governance frameworks (e.g., model risk management, data lineage requirements, regulatory reporting) as they relate to Alation's platform. Help surface opportunities to expand product usage/consumption as a natural outcome of demonstrated value. Lead discovery sessions to surface business and governance challenges. Run product demonstrations and adoption workshops tailored to enterprise stakeholders. Build a defensible, data-backed value story that connects governance outcomes to measurable business impact, giving customers clarity on the value Alation delivers. Own end-to-end delivery of Alation implementations and services engagements,from kickoff through defined business outcomes. Define KPIs and value measures; help customers articulate how Alation contributes to their governance and strategic goals. Run enablement and adoption activities so governance practices are embedded into customer workflows, not just configured — helping customers govern their AI initiatives with the same rigor as their data. Contribute to Executive Business Reviews, presenting governance and business outcomes with supporting data. Partner with account teams to identify expansion opportunities emerging from your work. What You Bring Minimum 6+ years of consulting experience in a lead role with a proven track record of delivering successful projects that achieve measurable business outcomes by effectively addressing complex data management requirements, often within budget and with a focus on urgency. Experience delivering services as part of a software company, understanding the dynamics of product implementation and customer success in the context of driving business results through technology. Extensive data management experience with a focus on how data governance, data quality, master data management, and/or reference data directly enable business capabilities and contribute to achieving strategic objectives. Demonstrated expertise in at least one target industry (Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and/or Hospitality and Travel) and its governance/regulatory landscape. Working understanding of data governance and AI governance concepts, metadata management, and how they map to platform capabilities. Hands-on configuration/build experience is a plus, not a requirement. Energized and excited about thriving in a high-growth, startup environment where urgency and impact are valued, particularly in delivering data management solutions that drive business outcomes. Passionately curious and committed to continuous learning and proactively innovating and improving both personally and professionally, staying ahead of industry trends and Alation capabilities to better advise customers on achieving business results through data management. Comfortable and effective working in a non-traditional office environment using virtual teaming and working remotely, demonstrating strong collaboration skills regardless of location to partner effectively with customers on their journey from data requirements to business outcomes. Deeply passionate about ensuring customers achieve maximum value out of their investment, acting as their advocate and partner in translating their data management needs into tangible business success. title: Sr Business Analyst
jd: Airbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations as an Equal Opportunity Employer to applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation to complete your application, please contact us at USCareers@airbus.com Notice: Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal Notice: Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination (English) Aviso: Transparencia en el Pago No Discriminación (Spanish) Job Description: Job Summary: As a Senior Business Analyst for Contractor Logistics Support (CLS), you are not merely a data reporter; you are a strategic architect of program efficiency and an integral part of PBH contracts for AHI. You will provide high-level financial oversight for the LUH (Lakota) Program, serving as the primary engine for process improvement and critical analytical insights. Your mission is to safeguard the financial health by transforming raw operational data into actionable business intelligence and identifying systemic opportunities for cost avoidance and revenue protection. This role merges advanced financial modeling with technical reliability engineering. This role ensures the fleet's technical performance is accurately reflected in the financial baseline and leads the "technical-contractual filtering" process to protect program margins. Your Working Environment: A suburb just outside the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area is home to Airbus Helicopters U.S. regional headquarters, where we have more than 1,000 employees. Check out one of the seven professional sports teams that also call Dallas home - you may even see a special, custom Airbus helicopter dedicated to the Dallas Cowboys flying during home games. How we care for you: Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”) Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program. Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages. Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility. Your Challenges: Strategic Analytic Engineering & Contract Governance: 40% ● Process Architecture: Evaluate current data collection methods for the CLS Program and design procedural enhancements to increase data velocity and accuracy. ● Root Cause Variance Analysis: Conduct deep-dive forensics on actual vs. planned financial performance. Instead of just identifying gaps, you will diagnose the "why" behind variances and partner with accounting to prevent future deviations. ● Performance Optimization: Analyze project performance against internal targets, proactively recommending corrective actions to keep the program on its strategic trajectory. ● Drive the Monthly Action Plan (MAP) with Finance and Contract Management to ensure strict adherence to the Estimate at Completion (EAC) scenario. ● Cost Centralization: Implement and manage the Coyote, Skywise and Alteryx tools across the CLS contract to ensure data consistency at the part level. ● Strategy Development: Build the business case for future CLS renewals, focusing on parts coverage, performance commitments, and Time & Materials (T&M) potential. Predictive Planning & Forecasting: 40% ● Anticipatory Budgeting: Drive the preparation of the annual operative plan using sophisticated forecasting models (EAC, ETC). ● Technical-Contractual Filtering: Assist Tech Reps/CFMs on whether maintenance events are covered under contract or should be invoiced as exclusions. ● Maintenance Manual Optimization: Collaborate with Tech Reps/Engineering to update Maintenance Manuals to eliminate room for interpretation and reduce unnecessary costs. ● Warranty Governance: Manage a dedicated Warranty Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) to track and recover reliability-driven costs. ● Strategic Input: Provide high-level insight for periodic forecast updates, ensuring that the LUH activity is positioned for long-term fiscal stability including predictive modeling for event-based maintenance events. Help track and monitor a line of balance for repairables and consumables along with support from the technical team. ● Metric Framework Development: Establish and govern a suite of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) focused on Forecast Accuracy (FA), Mean Time Between Unscheduled Removals (MTBUR, MTBR (covered events), MTBF, SLLs, TBOs, LLPs), and Stock-Out Frequency. Operations & Visualization: 20 % ● Systemic Refinement: Lead the ongoing automation of internal financial reporting. Your goal is to reduce manual intervention, eliminate human error, and ensure 100% data integrity. ● Internal Control Governance: Critically assess reporting policies to ensure they not only meet compliance standards but also provide the most transparent view of program health. ● Ad-Hoc Strategic Support: Execute complex, high-stakes simulations and analyses to support senior leadership in executive decision-making. ● Financial Safeguarding: Act as a critical liaison between Finance and the Customer to manage maximum funded events, ensuring that contractual thresholds are monitored with predictive accuracy rather than reactive reporting . Your Boarding Pass: ● Must have a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (4 years) ● Must have 6 or more years of experience in data analytics with a proven track record of building sophisticated dashboards that simplify complex or abstract data into clear narratives. . ● Advanced Tools (Preferred): SAP (BPC/BW modules), Alteryx, Tableau, and Smartsheet Familiar with SAP and reporting systems such as Skywise, Tableau, Snowflake or Power BI ● Systems Logic: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Advanced Modeling) and PowerPoint or Google equivalents. Travel Required: ● 20 % Domestic and International Citizenship: ● Must be a US Person under ITAR definition (U.S. Citizen, green card holder or person covered under our existing ITAR license) Clearance: ● Ability to obtain and maintain a Government security clearance (common access card) Physical Requirements: ● Onsite or remote: 80% onsite in Grand Prairie, TX when not on travel ● Vision: able to see and read computer screens and other electronic equipment with screens, able to read documents, reports and engineering drawings. Daily ● Hearing: able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. Daily ● Speaking: able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. title: Director, Enterprise Manufacturing Applications
jd: At Alcon, we're passionate about enhancing sight and helping people see brilliantly. With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. We foster an inclusive culture, recognizing your contributions and offering opportunities to grow your career like never before. Together, we make a difference in the lives of our patients and customers. Are you ready to join us? We foster an inclusive culture and are looking for diverse, talented people to join Alcon. Alcon is accelerating its digital manufacturing ambitions, integrating modern operational technologies with enterprise digital systems to enable world‑class performance across its 16+ global manufacturing sites. Central to this transformation is the strategic development, deployment, and optimization of enterprise manufacturing applications—including MES, SCADA, CMMS, calibration systems, and other foundational IT/OT platforms. The Director of Manufacturing Enterprise Applications will own the strategic direction, business value, and lifecycle performance of these mission‑critical applications. This leader will guide global standardization, drive utilization and capability maturity, evaluate new technologies, and ensure that Alcon’s manufacturing systems remain at the forefront of operational excellence. This role sits within the global Manufacturing Excellence organization and leads a high‑performing team responsible for orchestrating technology strategy, program delivery, system adoption and best practices, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing sites. You will also serve as the business owner for global KPI dashboards, evolving them into predictive and prescriptive tools for metrics such as Purchase Price Variance (PPV), Inventory, Yield, OEE, Schedule Attainment, and more. In this role, a typical day will include: Strategic Leadership & Vision Define the global strategy and long‑term roadmap for enterprise manufacturing applications across MES, SCADA, CMMS, calibration systems, and related OT platforms. Partner with manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and IT leadership to ensure technology strategies align with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and site needs. Establish and evolve enterprise standards, architecture, and governance models for manufacturing applications across 16+ sites. Actively monitor emerging technologies, industry trends, and digital manufacturing innovations to drive transformative solutions. Enterprise Application Ownership Serve as the business/system owner for key global manufacturing applications, accountable for system design, capability development, compliance, performance, and user adoption. Lead global planning, budgeting, and prioritization of application enhancements, upgrades, lifecycle management, and new platform introductions. Drive harmonization of manufacturing workflows, data structures, and application configurations to reduce complexity and increase scalability. Ensure systems effectively integrate with ERP, PLM, QMS, supply chain, and other enterprise platforms. Program Delivery & Continuous Improvement Oversee global implementation programs—including new deployments, upgrades, migrations, and optimization projects—ensuring high quality, on‑time, and within budget delivery. Champion the use of advanced capabilities such as predictive analytics, digital workflows, IIoT connectivity, and process automation through integrations. Develop and execute continuous improvement strategies to expand system utilization, reduce downtime, and enhance data usability. Enable standardized KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure system effectiveness and drive data‑driven decision‑making. Cross-Functional Partnership Act as the primary liaison between Manufacturing Excellence, IT, Quality, and operations to ensure aligned priorities and smooth execution. Collaborate with cybersecurity, validation, and compliance teams to ensure systems meet all regulatory and security requirements (e.g., FDA, EU MDR, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity). Build strong relationships with site leadership teams to understand business needs and ensure platforms are effectively supporting operations. Team Leadership & People Development Lead and develop a global team of technical and functional experts across manufacturing systems, digital platforms, and project delivery. Foster a high‑performance, inclusive culture centered on transparency, collaboration, innovation, and customer focus. Ensure the organization has the right skills, capabilities, and long‑term talent pipeline to support future digital manufacturing initiatives. What You'll Bring to Alcon: Bachelor’s Degree or Equivalent years of directly related experience (or high school +18 yrs; Assoc.+14 yrs; M.S.+7 yrs; PhD+6 yrs) The ability to fluently read, write, understand, and communicate in English 10 Years of Relevant Experience 6 Years of Demonstrated Leadership Preferred Qualifications: Experience in the medical device, pharmaceutical, or highly regulated manufacturing environment. Knowledge of ISA‑95, ISA‑88, and digital manufacturing standards. Familiarity with cloud‑hosted architecture, IIoT platforms, and advanced analytics technologies. Demonstrated ability to build business cases and deliver measurable operational value through technology. Strong vendor management experience with major MES/SCADA/OT providers. Leadership Characteristics Strategic Thinker: Able to translate enterprise goals into system strategies and structured roadmaps. Technical Credibility: Comfortable diving into system design, architecture, and manufacturing workflows. Change Leader: Skilled in navigating organizational complexity and driving global standardization. Communicator & Influencer: Effectively partners across diverse functions, cultures, and levels. Customer-Oriented: Focused on improving the experience and effectiveness of manufacturing sites. title: Business Systems & Operations Analyst, Supply Chain
jd:
Tecovas was founded with the simple goal of making the world's best western boots, apparel and leather goods - and selling them at a fair price. We are a brand revolutionizing a category and welcoming first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike.

Tecovas is looking for a Supply Chain Business Systems & Operations Analyst to own and improve the systems, data, and processes that power our product lifecycle and vendor compliance work. Reporting directly to the Manager, Supply Chain Business Systems & Operations, you will serve as the business owner of our product lifecycle management platform, build our vendor compliance system of record, and partner across Supply Chain, Merchandising, Product Development, and Tech to keep critical product data accurate and connected.

This role is required to be based in Austin, TX. Candidates must either be currently located in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the product lifecycle management (PLM) platform from the business side, gathering requirements, prioritizing enhancements, and defining workflows, fields, naming, and taxonomy.
  • Build and maintain the vendor compliance system of record, including document intake, verification, storage, status, expiration, renewals, exceptions, audit reports, and corrective action plans.
  • Consolidate existing vendor compliance records into a verified baseline and establish clear standards for what must be on file by partner type.
  • Build and execute test plans for system changes, lead user acceptance testing, and document release notes, known issues, and workarounds.
  • Own the Time & Action calendar and support Product Development with milestone templates, seasonal setup, style data, and bill-of-materials completeness.
  • Govern product data standards and run regular data-quality audits to resolve issues before they impact integrations, launches, or product pages.
  • Own business-side integrations between the PLM and downstream systems, monitoring data flows, troubleshooting discrepancies, and partnering with Tech on field mappings and technical issues.
  • Own user access, support, training, and documentation, while identifying and fixing the root cause of recurring system issues.

Experience we’re looking for:

  • 3-5 years of experience as a business systems analyst, PLM administrator, product data manager, or similar role.
  • Hands-on experience owning and configuring a PLM platform such as WFX, Centric, PTC FlexPLM, Bamboo Rose, or a comparable system.
  • Experience building or managing a structured records process, including document requirements, storage, status, expiration, and renewal.
  • Experience gathering requirements, leading user acceptance testing, rolling out system changes, and creating clear documentation and training.
  • Working knowledge of how a PLM connects to an ERP and other downstream business systems.
  • Familiarity with Time & Action calendars and bills of materials in a product development environment.
  • Strong data skills, including SQL or advanced spreadsheet capabilities.
  • Bonus points for apparel, footwear, or consumer products experience, and familiarity with NetSuite.

What you bring to the table:

  • You are highly organized and attentive to detail, especially when it comes to records, dates, data quality, and follow-through.
  • You can translate business needs into clear requirements and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
  • You are comfortable owning a high-impact system and making thoughtful decisions about processes, priorities, and data standards.
  • You approach support with a problem-solving mindset and look for the root cause of recurring issues rather than treating them as one-off tickets.
  • You write clear, practical documentation that people can actually use.

Full Time Benefits & Perks:

  • We offer insurance plans that pay 79-90% of your health premium coverage and 100% of your dental & vision insurance coverage for your family/dependents
  • 401(k) match
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Corporate wellness program

  • Eligibility to participate in Corporate Bonus Program
  • Generous employee discounts!

title: Staff Engineer, Technical Lead, Content Management Systems
jd:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. 

Oura is looking for a Staff Engineer, Technical Lead to lead a new engineering team responsible for building and evolving a content management system used by multiple business teams and capable of publishing to multiple digital mediums across Oura. This team will be organizationally aligned to the Commerce Mission, with an initial focus on supporting our consumer website, ouraring.com; our blog, The Pulse; and our business website, organizations.ouraring.com.This role is a strong fit for a talented engineer who is comfortable operating across the technical stack, can guide architecture and delivery, and can coordinate work across a team of contributors. The right candidate will bring practical experience with content management systems, solid technical judgment in cloud-based environments, and the ability to partner effectively with engineering, product, design, marketing, and other business stakeholders.

What You Will Do:

  • Lead a new engineering initiative focused on content management capabilities that serve multiple business teams across Oura.
  • Define the technical direction for a CMS platform that supports publishing to multiple digital properties and channels.
  • Partner closely with the PM and cross-functional stakeholders to understand content workflows, publishing needs, governance requirements, and long-term platform opportunities.
  • Drive architecture and implementation decisions across front-end and back-end systems, with an emphasis on scalability, maintainability, reliability, and ease of use.
  • Establish strong engineering practices for system design, delivery, observability, quality, and operational excellence.
  • Contribute directly to technical problem solving, code delivery, design reviews, and key implementation decisions.
  • Help the team balance short-term delivery for prioritized surfaces with longer-term platform investment.
  • Build strong working relationships with teams across Commerce and adjacent business and technical organizations.

This is a remote role based in the US.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of engineering experience
  • Experience leading large engineering projects, including technical direction and delivery planning,
  • Experience with agentic coding and emerging AI technologies.
  • Experience working with content management systems, including platform selection, implementation, integration, customization, or evolution in a multi-team environment.
  • Strong technical proficiency across the stack, with the ability to work effectively in both front-end and back-end codebases.
  • Experience designing and operating systems on a modern cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, APIs, integrations, data flows, security considerations, and operational reliability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and align multiple stakeholders around platform direction, tradeoffs, and execution plans.
  • Comfort operating in an ambiguous environment where the team, platform boundaries, and roadmap are still being shaped.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building or supporting multi-site, multi-channel, or headless CMS architectures.
  • Experience partnering with marketing, content, digital, or web teams on publishing workflows and content operations.
  • Experience in e-commerce, growth, or customer-facing web platforms.
  • Familiarity with modern web architecture, experimentation, personalization, SEO, and content performance considerations.

title: Staff Strategic Sourcing Manager - Logistics
jd:

We are looking for a Staff Strategic Sourcing Manager, Logistics to own sourcing strategy, supplier management, and commercial execution across key logistics spend categories that materially impact Oura’s cost of goods sold, with an initial focus on logistics, warehousing, freight, returns, and related business operations spend.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role within the Sourcing team. The person in this role will bring strategic sourcing discipline, strong commercial judgment, and cross-functional influence to drive measurable savings and create long-term supplier strategies.

This role works closely with Logistics, Finance, Operations, Program Management, and external supplier partners to ensure that Oura’s logistics sourcing decisions support service levels, scalability, and total landed cost objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own sourcing strategy and commercial execution across logistics, warehousing, freight, returns, and related categories
  • Lead RFQ, RFP, and competitive bid processes, including supplier selection, pricing negotiations, SLA alignment, contract terms, and multi-year commercial agreements
  • Deliver measurable cost reductions across freight, 3PLs, and returns providers through supplier benchmarking, cost modeling, and vendor negotiations
  • Build and maintain dashboards, cost models, and reporting workstreams that track spend, savings, supplier performance, and key cost drivers across the portfolio
  • Establish KPIs and supplier scorecards covering cost, service, quality, on-time performance, and responsiveness, and lead regular business reviews to drive accountability
  • Partner with Logistics, Finance, Operations, and Program teams to align sourcing decisions with service requirements, launch timelines, forecast changes, and business priorities
  • Strengthen supplier governance and contract management to improve decision-making and operational execution and build long-term strategic partnerships
  • Standardize sourcing processes, commercial documentation, and supplier management practices to improve scalability

Qualifications

Required:

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee your team's integration of PLM with ERP, MES, and the ECAD/MCAD toolchain so that a change released in engineering propagates correctly to planning, procurement, and the shop floor without manual re-entry
  • Direct your team's delivery of MES capability for electronic work instructions, digital travelers, operation-level data collection, serialization, genealogy, station-level quality gates, and test data capture at the point of work
  • Lead your team's delivery of Quality systems capability — document and training control, nonconformance and CAPA, supplier quality, incoming and in-process inspection, calibration, audit management, and change control — and establish closed-loop routing of production and field findings back into engineering change
  • Set strategy for enterprise systems delivery on the Salesforce platform where it supports business processes adjacent to the product lifecycle — customer and program management, service and field support, warranty and returns, and case-to-quality handoffs
  • Represent the function to Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Program Management leadership to elicit, prioritize, and negotiate business requirements; direct your team in translating them into well-architected system configurations, workflows, and integrations
  • Set direction for the business processes that operate within these systems, ensuring your team designs and continuously improves them to be scalable, auditable, and aligned with internal controls
  • Ensure your team delivers data readiness for prototype, pilot, and production builds in support of new product introduction — long-lead part release, make/buy decisions, supplier data packages, and as-built records
  • Lead your team through implementation, upgrade, and module rollout projects end-to-end — planning, scoping, conference room pilot, testing, UAT, cutover, hypercare, and post-go-live optimization
  • Own the vendor relationship strategy for systems integrators, VARs, and software vendors: statements of work, deliverable acceptance, change orders, licensing, renewals, support escalations, and roadmap alignment

  • Establish and govern master data practices across parts, suppliers, customers, BOMs, routings, and locations; hold your team accountable for data quality, reconciliation, and reporting standards
  • Ensure your team builds and maintains reporting, dashboards, and analytics that give business leaders timely visibility into engineering change cycle time, BOM accuracy, first-pass yield, NCR and CAPA closure, on-time release, and user adoption
  • Own change management and adoption strategy: stakeholder analysis, communication plans, role-based training, super-user networks, and post-go-live adoption metrics

  • Experience leading teams that deliver quality system capability in a dedicated QMS or PLM-embedded quality module, such as Teamcenter Quality, ETQ Reliance, MasterControl, Veeva QualityOne, TrackWise, or Greenlight Guru

  • Own manufacturability and scale-up

You will own the complete lifecycle—architecture, design, integration, and verification—of the upper body stack. This position requires a rare blend of deep kinematic expertise and the ability to solve extreme "packaging" challenges, where high-performance compute, high-density batteries, and sensitive perception sensors must coexist within a compact, dynamic, and thermally-constrained frame. Responsible for incorporating ID intent into final A-surfaces, ensuring that mechanical constraints (draft, wall thickness, cooling vents) do not compromise the iconic Apollo head design language and brand identity.
  • Aesthetic & Functional Synthesis: Manage the complex surfacing of the robot's "skin," ensuring seamless transitions between structural elements and aesthetic covers while maintaining IP (Ingress Protection) and thermal venting requirements.

Complex Mechanism Design

  • Kinematic Structures: Drive the development of high-performance robotic limbs. Design innovative mechanisms that manage extreme dynamic loads while maintaining the precision required for human-like manipulation.

High-Density Integration

  • Subsystem Packaging: Lead the tight-space integration of the compute cluster (NVIDIA Jetson/SoMs), battery modules, and perception sensors (LiDAR, Depth Cameras) within the torso and head.
  • Interconnect & Cable Management: Architect the routing strategy for complex wire harnesses through high-flex joints (shoulders, neck, elbows), ensuring multi-million cycle reliability and signal integrity.

Verification & Leadership

  • DVT Ownership: Define and execute the Design Verification Test (DVT) plan for the upper body stack, including environmental, vibration, and lifecycle testing.

jd:

At the core of every robot policy we ship is a simulation platform that has to be fast enough for RL training, accurate enough for controls validation, and stable enough to be the team's daily driver. As Staff Software Architect for Core Simulation Platform, you'll own the architecture of that platform — the distributed systems, performance engineering, and large-scale infrastructure decisions that let it run millions of parallel experiences a day. You don't need a deep robotics or simulation background to thrive here: what matters most is a track record of architecting complex, high-performance, distributed software systems. We'll pair you with senior team members who bring domain depth in physics and robotics.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the architecture of the core simulation platform — high-performance distributed systems that serve as the foundation for policy training, controls validation, and CI/CD integration testing.
  • Design and drive the build-out of cloud-native pipelines capable of generating millions of experience hours per day, architecting how compute-heavy workloads parallelize and scale for rapid iteration.
  • Define the platform's core abstractions and APIs, ensuring the system stays extensible as new physics, sensor, and rendering capabilities are added by domain specialists.
  • Set technical direction on performance, reliability, and scalability, identifying and resolving systemic bottlenecks in a large, high-throughput distributed system.
  • Define the platform roadmap and review major design proposals, ensuring improvements visibly reduce iteration time for RL, controls, and perception teams.
  • Partner with Controls, AI Research, and Perception leadership to translate their evolving needs into a coherent, extensible architecture as the platform grows.
  • Establish architectural standards and mentor senior engineers on system design, bringing outside experience in distributed systems and software architecture into a robotics context.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Excellent C++ and/or Python programming skills, with a strong track record of applying them to large-scale system architecture
  • Deep experience architecting distributed, high-throughput, or real-time software systems — this experience can come from robotics, gaming, simulation, high-frequency trading, large-scale backend infrastructure, or similar domains
  • Proven experience architecting workloads on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) with distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Ray, Kubernetes)
  • Deep familiarity with software development best practices: CI/CD, automated testing, and code quality standards
  • Track record of making and defending architectural trade-offs (performance vs. flexibility, latency vs. throughput) and communicating them clearly to engineers and leadership
  • Comfort ramping up quickly in a new technical domain, and partnering closely with subject-matter experts in physics, robotics, and ML to translate their needs into system design

At least one of:

  • Understanding of robotics concepts: kinematics, dynamics, controls, system identification
  • Experience with modern robotic simulators (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, or equivalent)
  • Understanding of Reinforcement Learning, with research or production experience

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in a software architecture or technical leadership role on complex, large-scale systems

title: Technical Lead Manager - Production Engineering
jd:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

Apptronik's Production Engineering team owns the engineering last mile — turning humanoid subsystems into a fully functioning, field-ready system and commissioning it on site under a Factory Acceptance Test (FAT). We are seeking a Manager to build and lead this new organization: a hands-on technical leader who sets the bar for deployment, integration, and reliability while growing and directing a cross-disciplinary team of software support, site-reliability, and hardware-configuration engineers. Reporting to the head of Infrastructure Software and working closely with the org's Architect, you will own the delivery of robots to Robot Park and customer sites — beginning with Apptronik's first external deployments — and be the technical and operational anchor for the team as it scales.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Team Leadership: Build, lead, and grow the Production Engineering team — software support, site-reliability, and hardware-configuration engineers — setting priorities, mentoring, and owning execution and quality.
  • Last-Mile Ownership: Own the engineering last mile end to end — integrating subsystems into a working humanoid and driving it to acceptance under Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) at Robot Park and customer sites.
  • Deployment Delivery: Champion on-site deployment, bring-up, and commissioning for internal and external customers.
  • Reliability & Uptime: Establish the standards, tooling, and on-call practices that keep a growing fleet running under real-world field conditions.
  • Fleet Deployment & Observability: Own centralized deployment and rollout across the fleet — canary, staged, and cascading — and the observability and monitoring that make rollout a decision, not a guess.
  • Technical Direction: Set technical direction for provisioning, configuration management, networking, and fleet tooling, making architecture and prioritization calls in partnership with the org's Architect.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Commercial, Service & Support, and the PMO to align deployment schedules, site requirements, and hand-offs.
  • Process & Scale: Define lightweight, repeatable processes — sprint cadence, deployment playbooks, and FAT criteria — that scale as the team and customer base grow.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Proven technical leadership — leading engineers and owning delivery of complex, cross-disciplinary systems.
  • Deep hands-on experience deploying, integrating, and commissioning complex hardware/software systems in the field, ideally robots.
  • Strong systems breadth across Linux, networking (DDS/UDP/TCP), provisioning and configuration management (Ansible), and software (C++/Python).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management; able to represent the team to senior leadership and customers.
  • Sound judgment under pressure at customer facilities against demanding timelines and SLAs.
  • Willingness to travel to deployment sites, up to 25% during active deployments.
  • Formal people-management experience — hiring, developing, and directing a team.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Direct humanoid, manipulation, or teleoperation domain experience.
  • Experience standing up a new team or function from scratch.
  • Experience with ROS 2, containerization/CI-CD, and fleet-management tooling.
  • ML / MLOps in the field — model fine-tuning, post-training pipelines, or dispatching training jobs (VLA / embodied-AI workflows).
  • Warehouse and industrial systems integration (WMS / WES / MES / WCS).
  • Cloud infrastructure and fleet backend services.
  • Deep back-end experience — TypeScript and Kubernetes.
  • Deep front-end experience — React, CSS, and interface design.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of software / robotics engineering experience, OR 4+ years of direct humanoid, manipulation, or teleoperation domain experience, including time in a lead or ownership role.
  • Demonstrated experience owning on-site deployment and commissioning of complex systems.
  • At least 2 years formal managerial experience leading or mentoring engineers and driving cross-team execution.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times
  • Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen
  • Hearing and speech to communicate

title: Product Manager
jd: ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Product Manager to help drive the next creative leap at Pika. In this high-impact, hands-on role, you'll help shape the core experience of our generative AI platform, empowering millions of creators to bring bold ideas to life with powerful, intuitive tools. If you love the intersection of technology and creativity, you'll thrive here. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own the roadmap and lead projects from initial idea to launch for a key area of our creative platform. - Work closely with talented engineers, designers, and researchers to turn visionary ideas and AI advancements into delightful user experiences. - Define and track success metrics, using data, feedback, and creative insights to uncover what creators really need next. - Connect directly with creators and the Pika community to understand how generative AI inspires—and how we can go even further. - Write clear specs, rally the team, and help lead projects in our fast-moving, collaborative environment. - Collaborate smoothly across teams to align stakeholders and deliver great results. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 4+ years of product management experience in creative-tech, consumer platforms, or innovative startups. - Proven track record of shipping impactful features with minimal guidance, anticipating creative needs before they arise. - Strong product sense and creative instincts—especially when working in uncharted or ambiguous areas. - Great communicator who inspires teams and fosters collaboration through clear, concise writing and conversation. - Genuine excitement about the creative revolution enabled by generative AI—and a drive to explore where it can take us next. - Responsible, organized, and able to juggle priorities while staying on top of every detail. - Enjoys building relationships and working across different teams to make things happen. - Passionate about products that empower creative people and help them do their best work. BONUS POINTS - Experience with consumer, media-rich, or collaborative creation products. - Thrives in 0–1 or “blank page” startup environments. - Technical fluency or the ability to collaborate closely with engineering on creative tradeoffs. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive salary at the frontier of AI - Equity in a rapidly growing creative AI startup - Comprehensive benefits, monthly creative stipends, and team retreats - Flexible remote work, or join us in our vibrant Palo Alto office—where inspiration, ambition, and fun all come together ABOUT PIKA Pika is reimagining creative expression with AI. We’re building breakthrough tools to make video creation radically intuitive, lightning-fast, and accessible to everyone. Our culture thrives on smart people, great teamwork, and a shared passion for shaping the future of creativity. We're open to remote team members, or you can join us at our Palo Alto HQ (in-office 3–5 days a week) to help invent what’s next in creative AI.

title: Senior Product Manager
jd: ABOUT PLAYLAB Playlab is a tech non-profit dedicated to helping educators and students become critical consumers and creators of AI. We believe that an open-source, community-driven approach is key to harnessing the potential of AI in education. AI is a new design material and should be shaped by many to bring their ideas about learning to life. We equip communities with software and hands-on learning that empowers educators & students to build AI apps for their unique context. If you're passionate about building creative, equitable futures for students and teachers, we hope you'll join us. THE ROLE This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who wants to shape how educators and students build with AI. Your product work will: - Expand what's possible: Add new capabilities (e.g., components, agents) that expands how creators craft ai native software for their contexts. - Deepen the context: Build on our current work on curriculum knowledge graphs and organizational knowledge bases to deepen how creators can leverage their context. - Set the safety standard: Push the boundaries on what responsible and safe AI in education looks like. This includes advancing our moderation and safety systems; supporting learnability, legibility, and interpretability within the product; collaborating with key ecosystem partners; and open sourcing as much of this work as we can to advance the ecosystem. You'll work directly with our CTO, engineering team, ML team, designers, and partnerships team. You'll hear directly from educators through our deep partner relationships. And you'll make product decisions that affect how educators and learners across the globe experience AI in education. This role requires comfort with ambiguity. Playlab is an early-stage product with significant scope, a growing team, and limited existing product process. You'll need to build that process as you go and not wait for someone to hand it to you. If you need a lot of structure to do your best work, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive when you can shape the environment around you, read on. WHAT YOU'LL DO Drive Product Execution - Prioritize ruthlessly, write clear specs, and work with design, engineering, and learning teams to ship - De-risk builds by breaking work into meaningful increments that let us learn as we go - Make tradeoffs when scope, timeline, and resources collide and communicate those tradeoffs clearly Go Deep on the Details - Write detailed requirements that align design, engineering, and go-to-market teams - Understand the technical constraints and possibilities, and work side-by-side with engineering - Engage directly with users, and gather user feedback, usage data, and partner insights to inform decisions Build Product Process - Establish rituals, artifacts, and communication patterns that help a growing team stay aligned - Create clarity about how product decisions get made, without slowing the team down - Document what's working so others can build on it Collaborate Across Teams - Work with Learning and Partnerships to translate field feedback into clear priorities and simpler designs - Coordinate with design to ensure what we build is usable, not just functional Refine Strategy as You Learn - Pressure-test strategic assumptions against what you see in the product and hear from users - Surface when priorities should shift, and make the case with evidence - Help leadership make better decisions by bringing clarity to ambiguous situations YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU... - Have 7+ years of product management experience, including at least one early-stage or high-growth environment where you had to build process, not just follow it - Have led product development for AI-powered or technically complex products—you can work fluently with ML and engineering teams - Get energy from the details: you'd rather write a clear spec than a strategy deck - Ship fast without cutting corners: you know how to de-risk builds and make incremental progress - Thrive in ambiguity and can make good decisions with incomplete information - Communicate crisply: you can explain complex tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences - Care about education, equity, or mission-driven work; this isn't just a job, it's a chance to shape how AI shows up in schools BONUS POINTS FOR... - Experience in edtech or deep familiarity with how products land in K-12 or higher ed environments - Background working on platforms or tools where users build things (not just consume content) - Experience with responsible AI, content moderation, or trust & safety product work - Deep familiarity with the AI/LLM product landscape WHY JOIN US? Build the Product Function: You'll be Playlab's first PM and will get the chance to shape how product management works here. Meaningful Scope: You'll own strategic pillars that directly affect whether educators can build AI tools that transform their classrooms. Mission-Aligned Team: Join a small, passionate group committed to equity, creativity, and joyful learning. Direct User Connection: Playlab's deep partnerships mean you'll hear directly from educators Flexible Work: Remote-first environment with autonomy and a strong culture of collaboration. Occasional travel for partner meetings and team gatherings. Competitive Pay & Benefits: Includes salary, healthcare, retirement, generous time off, and opportunities for professional growth.

jd: ABOUT PLAYLAB Playlab is a tech non-profit dedicated to helping educators and students become critical consumers and creators of AI.
