title: Contract - Sr Project Manager
jd:
The Contract Sr. Project Manager will plan, direct, and coordinate project activities to ensure project and team objectives are accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters. 

Coordinates cross-functional projects and assumes a leadership role in shaping priorities, setting and tracking schedules, driving issue resolution, and ensuring quality.

Requires strong project management skills, a strong technical knowledge in software implementation, and proven experience managing key customer relationships and project details. 

This position is offered on a contract basis with an anticipated end date of December 31, 2027. 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensures the timely and accurate delivery of contract deliverables and key project artifacts across multiple projects.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact with key customers for implementation of GHX core products, leading coordination calls and aligning GHX activities with customer activities.
  • Leads and facilitates project “kickoff“ sessions to review assumptions and expectations, gather requirements, educate internal stakeholders on products and services, etc.
  • Builds detailed project plans and schedules, identifying deliverables, milestones, and required tasks, while independently managing the day-to-day operational and tactical aspects of multiple large-scale projects.
  • Directs and coordinates project personnel to keep the project on schedule, providing early visibility to milestones at risk and supportive analysis on the use of resources. Influences across the project scope without authority and works through ambiguous situations to reach tactical resolutions and go-forward action plans.
  • Maintains an overall program-level risk and issue log. Facilitates risk mitigation and issue resolution across functional managers and sponsors to minimize impact to project schedule and internal stakeholder satisfaction. Aligns to strategic needs of the client, as well as best practice experiences.
  • Conducts regularly scheduled meetings with stakeholders that continue to progress the project per charter / guidelines formulated at project initiation.
  • Understands the business fundamentals, provides routine updates to senior leadership (both client and GHX) on assigned projects, in the form of routine project check in meetings, and/or formal project readouts. Areas needing escalation are provided and resolved through mutual senior management teams.
  • Provides leadership, mentoring, and motivation to project team members throughout the project life cycle. Holds team members accountable to commitments and aligns to overall project status reporting/escalation transparently.
  • Assists the teams with project best practices, techniques, and tools for planning, execution, ongoing milestone/deliverable tracking, communication, and key performance metrics, and identifies and facilitates opportunities to improve those tools and processes.
  • Maintains product knowledge to increase efficiency in delivery of products.
  • Initiates change management reviews and contract modifications and identifies requirements for product and IT development.
  • Participation in vaccination programs as required by healthcare organizations credentialing guidelines.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience in project leadership roles
  • 5+ years of experience with software development, implementation or integration projects either in a leadership role or as a major team contributor. Must have a proficient understanding of the software implementation life cycle.
  • Advanced knowledge of project management methods and processes, including SDLC and Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks. Demonstrated success in delivering project scope on time and within budget.
  • Experience managing complex customer relationships and large clinical projects that are multi-threaded, including teams with more than 8 team members.
  • Excellent facilitation, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills, including well-developed interpersonal skills in a customer-facing role.
  • Ability to work in a team environment while remaining self-directed, proactive, and action oriented, with a demonstrated passion for learning new technology.
  • Strong analytical and qualitative reasoning skills, with the ability to diagnose project performance problems and execute effective corrective actions.
  • Significant experience with the Microsoft Office suite of solutions
  • ERP/MMIS experience required (or equivalent)
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment in complex situations and function independently with initiative, creativity, and attention to detail.
  • Healthcare Information Technology or Operational leadership experience.
  • Experience with integration technologies (HL7, FHIR etc).
  • Potential travel up to 25%.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PMP
  • Six Sigma
  • BPMN

Estimated hourly compensation $70.00 - $80.00

title: Seasonal Inventory Specialist – Nationwide Travel, TX
jd:
The Inventory Specialist is responsible for both traditional medical/surgical supplies management and 2-Bin Kanban project supply chain systems. This role is responsible for the accurate and efficient counting, stocking, and auditing of consumable medical/surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, surgical implants, instruments, and other hospital assets. This role may also be responsible for installing and maintaining 2-Bin Kanban project supply chain lines, including assembling and adjusting inventory storage racks. This is a temporary position that will require extensive travel.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Accurately capture inventory count data in the HITS program, utilizing Excel or paper count sheets as instructed by the Team Leader or other Inventory Management.
  • Perform inventory counts, ensuring all items are accounted for and reported according to established policies.
  • Report discrepancies in inventory to the Team Leader.
  • Maintain a high level of competency in using technology for inventory data capture, including the HITS application.
  • Regularly communicate with the Team Leader regarding any issues with the HITS program and/or computer equipment.
  • Assemble/disassemble and adjust inventory storage racks, carts, and shelving for supplies.
  • Install carts to each par location.
  • Organize and stock inventory shelving as directed by the supervisor and hospital staff teams.
  • Read data for supplies description, item number, par, and unit of measurement (uom).
  • Pick one (1) each of supplies for each par location and label with a temporary label.
  • Bin and stage supplies on carts with appropriate bin size and label.
  • Label bins and carts.
  • Accurately capture inventory count data in the HITS program using Excel or paper count sheets as instructed by the Team Leader or other Inventory Management.
  • Follow procedures and protocols outlined in job orientation and training.
  • Follow company procedures, guidelines, and standards in customer service, equipment utilization, and internet usage.
  • Maintain a high level of competency in utilizing technology for inventory data capture, including the HITS application.
  • Attend staff and training meetings for ongoing updates related to Field Operations.
  • Communicate with the Team Leader daily to troubleshoot challenges.
  • Collaborate daily with various teams while working on projects.
  • Follow Inventory Counter procedures and protocols outlined in job orientation and training.
  • Perform duties in a timely and effective manner, adhering to established company policies to achieve overall objectives.

Required Qualifications: 

  • High school education, GED or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Must be able to meet required standards to work within a hospital - including background check, drug test and medical vaccinations.
  • State Issued Driver’s License and clean driving record preferred in addition to reliable transportation and the ability to travel extensively.
  • Must possess a mobile phone to be able to use company apps for timekeeping purposes.
  • Ability to use inventory computer programs to update counts and compile reports.
  • Must present a professional appearance.
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of various teams.
  • Acute attention to detail.
  • Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities.
  • Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand the primary English language.
  • This position requires frequent travel across the US.
  • In accordance with hotel policy and the travel requirements of this role, applicants must be a minimum of 21 years of age.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Medical and/or pharmaceutical product knowledge.
  • 1 year of inventory count or supply chain experience is preferred.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to do the following:

  • Travel extensively to US based hospitals.
  • Stand and/or sit for prolonged periods.
  • Walking for prolonged periods.
  • Stooping, bending, and/or reaching to count products and/or handle equipment.
  • Perform repetitive motion activities.
  • Understand and respond to a diverse population.
  • Ability to lift up to 50lbs.

The compensation for the Clinical Inventory Specialist can range from $13.00 - $18.00 per hour. The base hourly range represents the anticipated low and high end of GHX’s salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and proficiency for the role. title: Senior Product Manager
jd: 🔗Are you being referred to one of our roles by a connection in Alira Health? If so, please apply using the referral link emailed to you. Join our global team dedicated to innovation and initiative, where physical walls and different time zones don’t limit, but encourage, collaboration. Where all contributions and new ideas are explored with an open mind and work is driven by our shared values: be courageous, be accountable, be honest, be inclusive and elevate others. Job Description Summary The Product Manager will own and evolve key areas of SpherePX, with a particular focus on AI-enabled care pathways and personalized digital health experiences. The role combines product management, healthcare, AI, behavioral insights, UX, and data to create solutions that improve patient and healthcare professional experiences while operating safely within a regulated environment. A major focus of the role is identifying where AI and personalization can meaningfully improve care journeys, while maintaining patient safety, privacy, transparency, appropriate human oversight, and measurable value. The Product Manager will contribute shaping the product roadmap and drive evidence-based product decisions, using user feedback, analytics, and real-world insights to measure outcomes, manage product risks, and continuously evolve the product in line with user needs, business priorities, and regulatory requirements. Ideal candidate: An experienced Product Manager with 10+ years of experience building complex digital products, strong systems thinking, UX and analytical skills, and experience with AI-powered and personalized user experiences. Healthcare/digital health experience, behavioral science expertise, and experience working in regulated environments such as MedTech or SaMD are strong advantages. In short: This is an end-to-end digital health Product Manager role at the intersection of AI, patient experience, behavioral science, and regulated healthcare, with significant ownership over translating complex care needs into scalable, safe, and measurable product solutions. Job Description THE ROLE Alira Health is an end-to-end partner for healthcare and life sciences, combining strategic, clinical, operational, data, and technology expertise to design and deliver patient-centered programs that create real-world impact. PCR-ENG is Alira Health’s Digital & AI Factory for precision health programs. SpherePX is a configurable platform that supports the full care continuum, empowering patients, clinicians, and operational teams through AI-enabled decision support while keeping humans in control. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to help shape the next generation of SpherePX and drive the evolution of our AI-enabled care pathway solutions. This person will play a critical role in creating intelligent, evidence-informed experiences that support proactive, personalized, and coordinated care. As AI becomes increasingly embedded within SpherePX, they will identify where it can create meaningful value for patients, healthcare professionals, and care teams, while ensuring it is applied in a safe, measurable, and human-centered way. We’re looking for a detail-oriented product specialist who can bring together clinical needs, patient experience, behavioral insights, operational complexity, and data to shape clear product requirements and effective solutions. This person will take end-to-end accountability for a product area, make high-impact trade-off decisions, and thrive in a fast-paced, agile, and regulated environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own the Product Area: Lead the care pathway product end to end. From discovery and problem definition through solution design, delivery, launch, performance measurement, and continuous iteration. Drive Product Intelligence: Continuously assess the external product and technology landscape by benchmarking relevant digital health solutions, monitoring emerging innovations, market trends, and best practices to inform product strategy and roadmap priorities. Translate Complexity into Clear Requirements: Turn complex clinical, behavioral, operational, and technical challenges into simple, actionable product requirements while validating user needs, pain points, and adoption barriers. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with clinical, engineering, design, regulatory, and operational stakeholders to ensure product decisions are feasible, coherent, scalable, and evidence-informed. Ensure Responsible AI, Governance, and Compliance: Ensure product decisions respect human-in-the-loop principles, patient safety, privacy, consent, transparency, auditability, and the regulated environment in which SpherePX operates. Manage Product Risk: Identify and escalate product, clinical, behavioral, AI, technical, and operational risks or dependencies early and recommend practical paths forward. Drive Continuous Improvement: Use qualitative feedback, behavioral and product analytics, performance data, and insights from live programs to continuously improve the product and care experience. Drive Backlog Prioritization: Translate strategic priorities, evidences, user needs, and technical considerations into a prioritized backlog with clear user stories and acceptance criteria. Maintain Product Documentation: Keep product documentation current and consistent throughout the SDLC to support regulatory requirements, traceability, effective delivery, and clear stakeholder communication. SKILLS 10+ years of Product Management experience , ideally with complex and scalable digital products or platforms. Excellent systems and critical thinking , with the ability to break down complex clinical, behavioral, and technical problems. Strong UX and human-centered product mindset , particularly for patient-facing and healthcare professional experiences. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills , including the ability to work effectively with technical, clinical, and business teams. Experience with personalized or adaptive digital experiences , with an understanding of behavior change, motivation, engagement, adherence, and patient decision-making. Experience designing AI-powered user experiences , with a track record of applying AI to enhance user journeys through intuitive, personalized, and context-aware interactions that support engagement, decision-making, and behavior change, while maintaining user trust, appropriate human oversight, and measurable user value. Strong analytical and data literacy , with the ability to interpret data, define success metrics, and make evidence-based decisions. Preference given to candidates with: Healthcare / Digital Health domain knowledge , with a solid understanding of care pathways, patient journeys, and healthcare ecosystems. Formal background in Behavioral Science, Psychology, Human Factors, or a related discipline. Experience in regulated healthcare environments , including digital health, MedTech, or SaMD. WORK ENVIRONMENT Working Language: English (fluent proficiency required). Ways of Working: Remote, cross-functional teams. Main Tools: Jira, Confluence, Figma, and Microsoft Suite. Languages English Education Contract Type Regular Salary Range The final offer will be determined within the applicable location-specific range and will depend on the candidate’s confirmed work location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and role scope. Europe: EUR 55,000–65,000 gross annually

title: Project Manager, Compliance
jd: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. About the Role Aligned is looking to add a Project Manager, Compliance to support our growth. This role leads enterprise-wide compliance projects that enable the company to obtain, maintain, and expand sustainability and energy certifications across its data center portfolio. The Project Manager is operationally focused: they run the work in live, mission-critical environments, drive cross-functional execution, and keep audit-ready evidence, schedules, and decisions moving until certification or recertification is complete. The ideal candidate has a compliance-analyst foundation and/ or is knowledgeable with controls, evidence, findings, and auditors. Additionally, they will have proven experience leading end-to-end enterprise projects. They partner daily with External Audit firms and internal owners in Finance, IT, Legal, Operations, Facilities, EHS, and Sustainability. Success is measured by on-time certification outcomes, clean audit cycles, and disciplined project control. What You Will Own Lead end-to-end project plans for enterprise sustainability and energy compliance initiatives (examples: ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001, SOC2, PCI, or equivalent portfolio programs). Build and maintain integrated schedules covering evidence collection, gap remediation, internal readiness reviews, external audit windows, and certification body submissions. Serve as the single operational point of contact for External Audit teams: coordinate site access, document requests, interviews, findings responses, and management representations. Coordinate stakeholder mapping with Finance, IT, Legal, Operations, Facilities, EHS, and Sustainability so owners, due dates, and artifacts are unambiguous. Track scope, risks, issues, dependencies, and change control; escalate early when audit findings, data gaps, or operational constraints threaten the critical path. Ensure projects do not compromise uptime, change-management discipline, or physical/cyber security requirements in live data centers. Establish a repeatable evidence repository (policies, SOPs, meters and utility data, training records, incident logs, contractor controls) that can be reused across sites and audit cycles. Prepare executive and steering-committee status: milestone health, open findings, budget vs. plan, and go/no-go recommendations for audit and submission dates. Drive post-audit remediation and recertification cadence so certifications remain current as the portfolio grows or operating conditions change. Capture lessons learned and harden standard work so subsequent sites and programs require less reinventing. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Compliance, Operations, Engineering, Environmental/Energy Management, Business, or equivalent experience. 3 or more years as a Project Manager leading Operational projects end-to-end. 3 or more years as a Compliance Analyst (or equivalent compliance / internal-controls / audit-support role) supporting enterprise or multi-site programs. Additional experience leading end-to-end enterprise-level projects from kickoff through close, including schedule ownership, stakeholder management, and delivery against committed dates. Demonstrated work with third-party auditors or certification bodies: evidence requests, findings, and remediation tracking. Working knowledge of at least one energy or environmental management / certification framework relevant to data centers (ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001, SOC2, PCI, or comparable), or clear ability to apply a compliance-analyst skill set to those frameworks. Ability to run projects in live 24x7 operations without disrupting availability or violating change-control standards. Strong written communication for audit narratives, evidence indexes, and executive status. Proficiency with project tools (MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent), AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, and the Microsoft 365 suite. Preferred Qualifications: Direct data center, oil and gas, renewable energy, public utility, or comparable industry experience. PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management credential. Experience coordinating enterprise PMO governance, internal audit, SOC-style evidence processes, or customer sustainability questionnaires alongside formal certifications. Prior partnership with Big 4, specialist sustainability consultants, or accredited certification bodies. Competencies That Distinguish Success: Compliance analyst rigor; knows the difference between a policy, a control, and proof the control operated. Enterprise project leadership; can take a multi-function certification program from charter to closed audit. Operational discipline; treats audits like production events: sequenced, documented, and reversible if something slips. Cross-functional gravity; can get Finance, Legal, IT, and site ops to produce the same artifact on the same date. Benefits & Perks: Aligned Data Centers is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our team members. Eligible employees have access to: Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts: HSA with employer contribution for eligible participants. FSA's offered for health and dependent care to increase tax savings. title: Manager Enterprise Applications – Dynamics & Digital Solutions
jd: Job Requirements Why work for us? Alkegen brings together two of the world’s leading specialty materials companies to create one new, innovation-driven leader focused on battery technologies, filtration media, and specialty insulation and sealing materials. Through global reach and breakthrough inventions, we are delivering products that enable the world to breathe easier, live greener, and go further than ever before. With over 60 manufacturing facilities with a global workforce of over 9,000 of the industry’s most experienced talent, including insulation and filtration experts, Alkegen is uniquely positioned to help customers impact the environment in meaningful ways. Alkegen offers a range of dynamic career opportunities with a global reach. From production operators to engineers, technicians to specialists, sales to leadership, we are always looking for top talent ready to bring their best. Come grow with us! Job Responsibilities: Own the operational performance and roadmap of Dynamics and digital applications. Provide day-to-day oversight of Managed Services and development partners. Hold providers accountable for SLAs, incidents, development quality, timelines, estimates, documentation, and project delivery. Maintain strong technical understanding of Dynamics 365 F&O, Dynamics CRM, Power Platform, SharePoint, and related technologies. Understand Dynamics architecture, Dataverse, configurations, customizations, environments, security, data structures, integrations, and application lifecycle management. Provide technical direction for Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint, web portals, and custom applications. Review application architecture and technical designs proposed by vendors. Challenge unnecessary customizations or overly complex solutions. Provide technical oversight for integrations between ERP, CRM, legacy systems, SaaS applications, and Data & Analytics platforms. Understand APIs, middleware, Azure integration technologies, Logic Apps, Power Automate, authentication, error handling, and integration monitoring. Partner with Finance, Sales, and Commercial stakeholders to understand requirements and improve business processes. Lead application participation in projects, enhancements, implementations, integrations, and upgrades. Ensure appropriate development, testing, documentation, deployment, and change-management practices. Coordinate closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, Data & Analytics, and PMO. Manage application technical debt and promote standardization. Develop the roadmap for Dynamics and related Microsoft platforms. Support Dynamics as a potential strategic platform within the future ERP consolidation strategy. Ensure application and technical knowledge is retained internally. Team Leadership and Management Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage a team of IT professionals, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. Resource Management: Allocate resources effectively, ensuring that the team is equipped to meet organizational needs and project deadlines. Performance Evaluation: Conduct regular performance reviews, set goals, and provide feedback to team members to enhance their skills and contributions. IT Strategy and Implementation Strategic Planning: Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and execute the IT strategy in alignment with the organization’s overall goals and objectives. Project Management: Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of IT projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and within budget. Technology Adoption: Evaluate and recommend new technologies and systems to enhance operational efficiency and improve service delivery. Operational Oversight IT Infrastructure Management: Ensure the stability, security, and performance of the IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, and cloud services. Incident Management: Oversee the incident management process, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and minimizing disruptions to business operations. Change Management: Implement change management processes to facilitate the smooth introduction of new technologies and updates, ensuring minimal impact on users. Budgeting and Financial Management Budget Oversight: Develop and manage the IT budget, ensuring prudent financial management and cost control in all IT activities. Vendor Management: Evaluate and manage relationships with third-party vendors and service providers, ensuring compliance with contracts and service level agreements (SLAs). Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement Cross-Department Collaboration: Work closely with other departments to identify technology needs, gather requirements, and provide IT solutions that enhance productivity. Stakeholder Communication: Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, providing regular updates on IT initiatives, projects, and performance metrics. Compliance and Security Policy Development: Develop and implement IT policies, procedures, and best practices to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. Cybersecurity: Oversee cybersecurity initiatives to protect the organization’s data and systems from potential threats and vulnerabilities. Education : Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree or relevant certifications (e.g., ITIL, PMP) preferred. 8+ years of experience in IT management or a related field, with a proven track record of managing complex IT projects and teams. 8–10+ years of enterprise application, ERP, CRM, or application-delivery experience. Strong Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience. Strong experience with Dynamics F&O and/or Dynamics CRM. Strong technical understanding of enterprise application architecture. Experience with Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse. Experience with SharePoint and Microsoft technologies. Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, middleware, and cloud integration concepts. Understanding of software-development concepts, testing, deployment, environments, and application lifecycle management. Strong Managed Services and vendor-management experience. Experience managing development and implementation partners. Understanding of Finance and/or Commercial business processes. Experience managing incidents, enhancements, releases, and projects. Dynamics CRM experience. Power Platform architecture and governance experience. Azure integration experience. Custom or web-application development background. Manufacturing experience. title: Senior Engineering Manager  | iOS Video Applications
jd:
The Opportunity Our iOS mobile team is part of the Adobe Video organization, where we build video creation and editing experiences for storytellers across desktop, mobile, and web. We move fast, care deeply about craft—and we’re hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to help lead that work on iOS! We want someone who will help define both what we build and how we build it. That includes establishing modern engineering practices and embracing AI‑assisted development to improve quality and speed. We’re looking for a manager who empowers their team to ship great iOS experiences while encouraging use of AI tools to move fast. We think you’ll thrive here if you bring people leadership and technical fluency. You communicate clearly across disciplines. And you enjoy working through trade‑offs with engineers and product partners to deliver the best outcome for customers. What You’ll Do You’ll lead, grow, and support a talented team of senior iOS engineers. Together, we build creative, user‑facing features—from early product and interaction design through execution and production quality. You’ll set technical and quality standards for the iOS organization. That means ensuring architectural coherence, maintainability, and performance across the codebase. We also need someone who can coach engineers on effective use of AI‑assisted development tools and agentic workflows. You’ll help the team accelerate responsibly while maintaining rigorous standards for code quality, correctness, and security. You’ll partner with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to shape product strategy. We want a collaborator who brings a clear technical and UX perspective—not just resourcing or delivery plans. You’ll guide the team in making thoughtful scope and priority decisions, balancing user impact, velocity, and long‑term technical health. We believe great products come from safe‑to‑experiment cultures. You’ll create that environment: validating assumptions early, learning from real user feedback, and treating each release as a chance to improve. You’ll develop talent through regular feedback, mentorship, and career growth conversations. And you’ll represent our iOS team in org‑level planning, advocating for investment, technical excellence, and a user‑centered approach! What We’re Looking For 10+ years of experience shipping Apple applications, with significant time delivering complex, production‑scale iOS products. Experience managing and growing teams of senior engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development. Technical fluency in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and the iOS SDK. You can review, guide, and influence architectural decisions even when not coding daily. Product instincts and UX sensibility—familiarity with Apple Human Interface Guidelines, a keen eye for interaction quality, and a feel for why details matter to users. Comfort operating in ambiguous problem spaces. You help teams move from unclear problem statements to crisp execution plans. Experience using AI‑assisted development tools at a team level—setting expectations, workflows, and guardrails for AI‑generated output. A clear, compelling communicator who translates between technical, product, and design perspectives. An understanding of mobile video editing workflows—or the curiosity and drive to develop that understanding quickly. Even Better If You Have A track record of influencing product direction, technical strategy, or design outcomes beyond your immediate team. Experience evolving engineering processes on growing teams (quality, reliability, release management). Experience building creative tools, video production software, or editing workflows. Hands‑on experience using video editing applications, with an appreciation for creative users’ needs. Familiarity with modern AI‑enabled developer tooling and practices. Why Adobe Video? We offer a small-team environment with big ownership — you'll work at the intersection of world-class creative software and AI-augmented engineering. We invest in our people with industry-leading benefits, including comprehensive health coverage, generous equity, flexible time off, and access to Adobe's full suite of creative tools. We believe diverse perspectives make our products better, and we're committed to building a team where everyone can do the best work of their careers. Are you ready to shape tools used by millions of creators worldwide? We'd love to hear from you About Adobe Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity. Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. jd: The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve. The Opportunity At Allegro MicroSystems, we make motors spin better than anyone else. As the industry shifts to high-voltage 800VDC AI factory architectures, thermal management has become the gating constraint: server and rack fans, CDU pumps, and liquid-cooling loops must move more heat per watt, in less space, than ever before. We are seeking a highly motivated, technical exceptional, and strategically minded Product & Segment Marketing Engineer to own, define, and scale our power management and motor driver portfolio for data center thermal management — fans, pumps, and liquid-cooling systems — across our global Data Center and AI Infrastructure business. In this hybrid role, you will lead both Product Development (from concept to release) and Business Development (from design-in to production) to win share at tier-one ODMs, OEMs, and reference-design innovators worldwide. What You Will Do 1. Product Development & Strategy (Concept to RTM) Portfolio Ownership: Drive the worldwide product strategy, roadmap planning, and long-term profitable growth for the Motors BU Data Center portfolio. Product Definition: Lead product definition by translating complex customer requirements, AI hardware trends, and competitive landscapes into differentiated IC concepts and clear Market Requirements Documents (MRDs). Business Case Justification: Build robust business cases (including TAM/SAM modeling, pricing strategies, and ROI/margin analyses) to justify new product kick-offs and secure alignment from BU leadership, design directors, and executive management. NPI Ownership & Launch: Own the commercial success of new programs through the entire lifecycle (Pre-RTM, Launch, and Post-RTM). Collaborate with systems, design, and applications engineering to resolve development hurdles, safeguarding Release to Market (RTM) timelines and profit margins. 2. Business Development & Global Market Execution (RTM to Production) Strategic Design Wins: Drive the pipeline from Sales Lead to Design-Win (DWIN) to grow net revenue while aggressively defending and maximizing gross margin profitability. Ecosystem Partnerships: Map, engage, and build deep partnership networks with key industry influencers, including major hyperscalers, hardware OEMs, reference design houses, distribution partners, and primary cooling ODMs. Regional Collaboration: Align with regional sales leadership and Field Application Engineers (FAEs) globally to identify high-value unassigned accounts, move them to active pipelines, and deliver localized technical marketing, demonstrations, and system-level architecture reviews. Collateral & Sales Enablement: Author compelling value propositions, competitive positioning strategies, technical product presentations, and training materials to equip global sales and distribution networks to effectively sell our motor driver and power management solutions. What You Will Need Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or a related technical field is required. 5+ years of experience in Semiconductor Product Marketing, Applications Engineering, Systems Engineering, or Technical Business Development. Strong understanding of analog/mixed-signal ICs, gate drivers, or motor control systems (BLDC/PMSM, sensor-less FOC), particularly as applied to fan and pump drives. Proven track record in portfolio management, TAM/SAM sizing, pricing strategies, and navigating product lifecycle management systems. Exceptional interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to build trust with tier-one customer executives and influence cross-functional engineering, operations, and senior leadership teams. Ability to travel globally 25–35% of the time to support international customers and sales teams. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE) and/or an MBA. Direct experience in power management or cooling solutions specifically optimized for enterprise computing, high-density servers, or communications infrastructure. Familiarity with the strict requirements of 48V and 800VDC power delivery ecosystems. Professional proficiency in English, with fluency in Mandarin Chinese and/or Japanese. Why Allegro? title: Senior Principal Digital SoC Architect
jd: The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve. Operating at the pinnacle of our technical career track, you will bridge the gap between high-level market requirements (electric vehicles, ADAS, autonomous systems, and AI data centers) and silicon implementation. This is a high-visibility, senior technical leadership role where you will define winning, highly integrated architectures, drive corporate IP reuse, steer technology platform roadmaps, and mentor engineering teams globally. What You Will Do SoC Architecture & Definition: Lead the architectural definition and technical specifications (Target Specs) of complex, mixed-signal SoCs. Define CPU/DSP subsystems, bus fabrics, memory maps, power management schemes, and digital/analog interfaces. IP Strategy & Reuse: Define and champion the digital IP roadmap (e.g., hardware accelerators, security blocks, communication protocols). Drive global IP reuse strategies to improve design quality and reduce time-to-market. Modeling & Feasibility: Develop architectural and transaction-level models to validate performance, latency, and power budgets early in the design cycle. Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Serve as the primary technical bridge between Product Marketing, Analog Design, Digital Design, Physical Design, Verification (DV/MSDV), and Software/Systems teams to ensure flawless top-level integration. Functional Safety & Quality: Architect safety-critical features to ensure compliance with automotive functional safety standards (ISO 26262 up to ASIL D) and security protocols (Evita/HSM). Technology & Process Roadmapping: Partner with Technology Development to select optimal silicon process nodes (e.g., SG8) and packaging technologies to meet cost, thermal, and performance goals. What You Will Bring B.S. or M.S. in Electrical or Computer Engineering (Ph.D. preferred) with a deep technical focus. 12+ years of experience in semiconductor digital design, with 5+ years acting as a lead SoC Architect. Deep experience integrating embedded processors (ARM Cortex-M/R, RISC-V), network-on-chip (NoC) interconnects, and memory subsystems (SRAM, Flash, NVM). Mastery of automotive and industrial protocols (CAN-FD, LIN, SPI, I2C, I3C, Ethernet, SENT). Functional Safety (FuSa): In-depth knowledge of ISO 26262 architectures, including lockstep cores, ECC, BIST/LBIST, and safety diagnostics. Expertise in multi-voltage domains, power gating, dynamic voltage frequency scaling (DVFS), and UPF-driven verification. High proficiency in system modeling (SystemC, MATLAB/Simulink) and digital front-end design tools (Verilog, SystemVerilog). A proven track record of mentorship (MTS level) and building consensus across highly matrixed, global teams. Excellent communication skills to simplify complex architectures for customers and business leaders alike. Desirable Experience Direct experience with smart motor control, brushless DC (BLDC) algorithms, or advanced magnetic sensing systems. Experience with hardware security modules (HSM) and cryptographic accelerators. Experience with mixed-signal design flows (MSDV) and top-level chip integration. Why Allegro? title: IT Platform Analyst

title: Solutions Architect - Data Science
jd: We’re hiring a Solutions Architect (Data Science) to drive technical engagement with Enterprise customers and partners across a variety of industries. In this role, you’ll connect real-world customer workloads to NVIDIA’s hardware and software ecosystem, helping developers and enterprises adopt and scale our platforms. We’re looking for someone with strong technical depth who can serve as a trusted advisor, bridge complex challenges to innovative solutions, and grow into a strategic resource for the customers and partners you support. This is a role that requires a combination of technical authority as well as good experience in managing technical partnerships and enablement with a strong presales focus. This role will help inspire our customers to reimagine, reinvent and operate enterprise business processes using Agentic AI, leveraging the NVIDIA platform. This is a highly technical role that requires deep expertise in generative AI, large language models (LLMs), Ai Frameworks and scalable software engineering practices, but also requires a focus on successfully managing projects and strong personal and organisational skills orchestrating both internal and external relationships with support from the broader ANZ NVIDIA team. The NVIDIA Solution Architecture team is the first line of technical engagement and expertise between NVIDIA and our customer ecosystem. Your duties will vary from trusted advisor and enablement to proof-of-concept demonstrations, driving relationships with key executives and managers to evangelize accelerated computing to leverage AI. Dynamically engaging with developers, scientific researchers, data scientists, IT managers and senior leaders is a meaningful part of the Solutions Architect role and will give you experience with a range of partners and concerns. If you’re excited about applied technology and enabling others to succeed with advanced platforms, we’d love to hear from you What you'll be doing: Becoming an NVIDIA AI expert and enabling developers to adopt NVIDIA Nemo and NIMs for their Generative AI offerings, platforms and client services. Co-design advanced, scalable architectures with Enterprise customers and Partners, defining technical direction, integration milestones, and deployment plans. Closely partner with other Solutions Architects, engineering, product and business teams at NVIDIA to build GenAI full stack solutions for industry vertical and enterprise use cases. Lead technical engagements, helping customers troubleshoot, resolve complex issues, and advocate for their technical needs. Creating or running Proof of Concept and Demos that require presentation skills, explanation of complex topics, writing Python code to execute data pipelines and train AI/DL models and deploy on container-based orchestrators. Document what you know, and guide others. This can vary from building targeted training for partners and other Solutions Architects to writing whitepapers, blogs, and wiki articles, to work through challenging problems with a partner on a whiteboard. Partner with APAC Regional and HQ Engineering, Product and Sales teams to develop, plan best suitable solutions for Partners. Enable development and growth of product features through customer feedback and proof-of-concept evaluations Running NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute and Skills Transfer sessions with Customers, OEM’s and partners around NVIDIA & others HW and SW solutions. What we need to see: Professional, long-term experience as a Data Scientist (focus on AI/DL/ML) developing/supporting customer facing projects experience on computer vision, Conversional AI, or data analytics technologies. BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, other Engineering or related fields (or equivalent experience) Strong customer-facing or presales/consulting and technical experience and skills with AI/ML/Big Data frameworks assisting them with. 5+ overall years of work-related experience in deep learning, data science or software development with knowledge of parallel computing with GPUs Strong development experience with RAG and workflows building Agentic AI applications. Good planning and long-term strategic engagement and orchestration with a broad ecosystem of stakeholders from customer, to internal and external parties. Developer experience with LangChain and LangGraph orchestrating LLMs. Working experience of Orchestration platforms like Kubernetes and datacentre including compute, storage, and networking. Clear written and oral communication skills with the ability to collaborate with management and engineering. Share knowledge with clients, partners and co-workers. You are a self-starter with attitude for growth, passion for continuous learning and sharing findings across the team, with excellent presentation, verbal and written communication skills and you are able to work remotely, planning well with strong partnering with a small team with an attitude for growth, passion for continuous learning and sharing findings across the team Ways to stand out from the crowd: Have experience leading technical teams working with partners and or customers, or consulting/advisor experience in the AI space. AI/Data Science project management, liaising with multiple stakeholders to drive projects, and coordinating resources inside (and outside if relevant) the organization. Proficient developer experience on NVIDIA SDK platform using Nemo and NIM, ML/DL frameworks and MLOps ecosystem of tools and solutions in the cloud and on-prem. Experience with cloud based solution designing, APIs and Microservices, orchestration platforms, storage solutions and data migration techniques Have a willingness and ability to dig into unfamiliar territories to tackle sophisticated problems and be a phenomenal listener. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking individuals in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jd: Meet the Moment with Alteryx We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Alteryx is looking for a senior planning architect who can lead the design and evolution of our connected planning environment. This role will own Anaplan architecture, technical roadmap, model standards, and major planning solutions across FP&A while helping Finance connect governed actuals, forecasts, scenarios, and reporting across systems. This is not a day-to-day Anaplan support role. The focus is on durable architecture, scalable planning design, complex solution ownership, and clear system boundaries. You will partner closely with FP&A, Finance Analytics Engineering & Automation, Finance Data & Analytics, and business stakeholders to determine how planning processes should be designed, integrated, and operated over time. Responsibilities Own connected planning and Anaplan architecture across the FP&A footprint, including model design, roadmap, scalability, performance, security, and major build decisions. Translate planning requirements and spreadsheet- or workflow-based processes into scalable planning solutions, and help determine when a use case belongs in Anaplan versus a data, automation, or reporting layer. Own Anaplan Data Hub architecture, application lifecycle management strategy, workspace and model design, release discipline, testing standards, and controlled production change. Establish reusable model-building standards, design patterns, documentation, runbooks, and backup coverage that improve maintainability and reduce key-person dependency. Lead major Anaplan builds and complex planning initiatives from solution design through implementation, validation, adoption, and ongoing support readiness. Partner with Finance Analytics Engineering & Automation on integrations between Anaplan, Snowflake, workflow automation, and downstream reporting, with clear ownership and control points across systems. Serve as the escalation point for complex Anaplan and connected-planning architecture questions, providing clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and downstream impact analysis. Coach and mentor Anaplan builders across the broader Finance team, using project-based support where appropriate while maintaining clear architecture standards and accountability. Partner with FP&A leaders and business stakeholders to evolve the connected planning roadmap across forecasting, annual planning, scenario analysis, workforce planning, revenue and bookings, and other priority use cases. Stay current on Anaplan capabilities and adjacent planning technologies, recommending improvements to scalability, user experience, automation, governance, and maintainability. Qualifications 6+ years of Anaplan experience, including demonstrated ownership of enterprise or multi-model architecture, technical roadmap, and major solution design. Deep proficiency in Anaplan Data Hub design, dimensional architecture, model performance, integration patterns, and implementation best practices. Strong command of Anaplan application lifecycle management, release management, testing, workspace and model strategy, and controlled production change. Proven ability to design, build, and troubleshoot complex Anaplan models, formulas, integrations, and performance-sensitive solutions. Strong understanding of FP&A and planning processes, including forecasting, annual planning, headcount, expense, revenue or bookings, scenario planning, and reconciliation to actuals. Experience designing planning user experiences and workflows that balance model architecture, usability, adoption, and planning-cycle reliability. Working knowledge of cloud data platforms, SQL, workflow automation, APIs, or comparable integration technologies sufficient to design clean system boundaries and integration contracts. Prior technical leadership, mentoring, or people management experience, with the ability to lead complex work even when contributors report through other teams. Preferred Experience Anaplan Solutions Architect, Master Anaplanner, or comparable advanced Anaplan certification. Experience integrating Anaplan with Snowflake, Alteryx, APIs, or other modern Finance data and automation platforms. Experience supporting connected-planning use cases across GTM, revenue, workforce, capacity, territory, quota, or other cross-functional planning domains. Experience with data governance, planning controls, reconciliation, metadata, or enterprise model standards. Experience operating in a SaaS or subscription business with complex forecasting and planning requirements. What Success Looks Like Anaplan operates as a stable, scalable planning platform with clear architecture, standards, documentation, release discipline, and backup coverage. Major planning initiatives can move from business requirement to production solution without relying on a single individual for architecture or troubleshooting. Planning data moves cleanly between Anaplan, governed data platforms, automation workflows, and reporting layers with clear controls and ownership. FP&A expands connected planning capabilities without creating unnecessary model complexity, duplicate solutions, or unmanaged technical debt. Validate detections with testing and retrospective analysis; continuously improve alert fidelity and response workflows. Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain monitoring and detection use cases that drive risk reduction and operational effectiveness. Perform basic endpoints and/or cloud forensics during escalated incidents and preserve evidence appropriately. Support malware triage and artifact analysis as needed during investigations. Investigate cloud-related threats and anomalies using cloud-native security signals and audit telemetry (AWS/Azure/GCP). Partner with Cloud/Platform teams to close investigation gaps (logging, retention, telemetry coverage) and validate remediation actions. Participate in an on-call rotation to provide 24x7 incident response coverage and serve as an escalation point for high-severity events. A master’s degree is a plus. 4+ years of relevant security operations / incident response experience Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and operational response practices. Strong experience with SIEM/log management platforms (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, ELK, Snowflake-based analytics, or similar) and demonstrated ability to query and analyze telemetry. Ability to analyze and interpret security-relevant data including security event logs, system logs, application logs, cloud logs, and device logs. Hands-on investigation experience using cloud-native security services (e.g., AWS Security Hub, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Google Security Command Center) and cloud logs. Experience with one or more scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, shell) to support investigations, enrichment, and analysis. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear ticket documentation, incident reporting, and stakeholder updates. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias toward action and operational rigor. Preferred Qualifications (One or More Areas of Depth) Forensics: Endpoint or cloud forensics, evidence handling, artifact interpretation, malware triage. Threat Hunting: Demonstrated experience leading hypothesis-driven hunts and operationalizing results into detections, playbooks, and response improvements (e.g., ATT&CK mapping and coverage tracking). Detection Engineering: Detection lifecycle ownership (build/test/deploy/tune/retire), alert quality improvement, playbook development. jd: Ameresco, Inc. (NYSE: AMRC) is a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions that provide reliable power and modernize infrastructure. Since 2000, we have served as a trusted partner to public and private sector customers across North America, the UK and Europe, delivering over $15 billion in solutions and contracting more than 5 GW of energy resources . At Ameresco, we integrate energy resources and modernize the built environment through innovative infrastructure solutions that improve reliability, optimize performance, strengthen resilience, and support long-term sustainability. Join us in building the infrastructure that powers the future. Explore opportunities to make a meaningful impact while growing your career with a company at the forefront of energy innovation. The Operations Manager – Medium Voltage is a newly created position and the first hire for Ameresco's Medium Voltage Operations & Maintenance Department. This role is responsible for building the department from the ground up, including hiring and developing crews, establishing operating procedures, and managing day-to-day execution across the company's national Solar PV and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) portfolio. The Operations Manager – Medium Voltage will lead the phased internalization of medium voltage preventative and corrective maintenance work currently performed by third-party contractors, with a goal of internalizing 95–100% of this scope over five years. This individual will also serve as Ameresco's internal subject matter expert for all things medium voltage, including oversight of third-party MV subcontractors performing work not yet internalized. This position reports directly to the Senior Director of Operations and holds accountability for department. This is a Remote position, but preferably the candidate will live in the Northeast to provide adequate coverage of Ameresco's Medium Voltage projects. Responsibilities: Department Buildout & Strategy Lead the phased hiring plan from the initial three-person crew through the full 21-person department over five years. Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Method of Procedures (MOPs), Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), and quality management systems for all medium voltage work types. Manage the phased transition of medium voltage work from third-party contractors to internal crews, ensuring no degradation in client service levels. Develop and manage relationships with preferred third-party MV contractors retained for surge capacity and specialty work. Subcontractor Management & Technical Oversight Serve as Ameresco's internal subject matter expert for all things medium voltage, providing technical guidance to Operations, Asset Management, and field teams. Manage and evaluate the performance of third-party MV subcontractors performing work not yet internalized, including scope, quality, and responsiveness. Remotely review and assess subcontractor-reported issues, testing reports, and deliverables (e.g., DGA results, relay test reports, infrared scans, cable test results) to validate findings and identify discrepancies. Make professional recommendations on next steps based on subcontractor findings, including repair versus replace decisions, escalation of critical issues, and prioritization of corrective action. Serve as the technical point of escalation for complex or ambiguous MV issues identified by internal crews or subcontractors. Operations Management Oversee scheduling, dispatch, and execution of all medium voltage preventative maintenance (PM) and corrective maintenance (CM) service requests nationwide. Ensure compliance with OSHA, NFPA 70E, and site-specific safety and regulatory requirements across all crews and regions. Manage crew travel logistics and regional coverage optimization as the department expands from the Eastern and Mid-Atlantic region to nationwide coverage. Own all department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) (see Measures of Success). Maintain accurate, timely records of all work orders, inspections, findings, and recommendations within Ameresco's CMMS platform, AssetPlanner. Inventory Management Perform initial onboarding and quarterly review of all operating MV equipment across Ameresco-owned and client-owned projects to identify critical MV spare parts required to support system operation. Source, procure, and stock components which are common across the fleet Update IMS Safety & Compliance Establish and enforce a zero-tolerance safety culture across all crews, targeting zero recordable incidents. Conduct quarterly safety reviews and unannounced field PPE and lockout/tagout (LOTO) compliance audits. Ensure all technicians maintain current certifications, PPE compliance, and training requirements. Training & Development Design and manage the department's training roadmap in partnership with AVO Training Institute, SEL University, and OEM training providers. Oversee the structured apprenticeship program, including required on-the-job training hours for advancement. Conduct annual skills matrix assessments and competency evaluations across all technician tiers. Develop succession plans and mentor Lead Technicians and other high-potential team members to build a leadership pipeline within the department. Financial Management Own the department's annual operating budget. Track and report third-party cost avoidance and net savings against the department's financial plan. Manage fleet, tooling, and consumable budgets, including vehicle procurement and replacement planning. Participate in or oversee an on-call rotation to support 24/7 emergency corrective maintenance response, including availability on weekends and holidays as needed. Perform other duties as assigned by the Senior Director of Operations. Minimum Qualifications: 10+ years of progressive experience in medium voltage electrical maintenance, with demonstrated multi-site, multi-OEM field experience. Master Electrician license or equivalent extensive medium voltage/high voltage field experience preferred. Industry certification pathways such as AVO Substation Maintenance I & II, Transformer Maintenance & Testing, and SEL protective relay application courses. OSHA-30 and NFPA 70E certification required. Additional Qualifications: Proven crew leadership, team-building, or department management experience within an electrical services, utility, or renewable energy environment. Direct experience with transformer diagnostics, switchgear maintenance, and protective relay systems (specifically SEL, ABB, or GE platforms). Demonstrated experience managing third-party MV subcontractors, including remote evaluation of testing reports, technical deliverables, and field findings. Experience working within a CMMS platform (e.g., AssetPlanner or similar) for work order management, asset records, and reporting is preferred. jd: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: $96,000.00 - $132,000.00 Location: Austin,TX You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . Join our ALD Manufacturing Engineering team. The primary role for this Technical Project Manager is supporting ALD New Product Transitions, but responsibilities can flex into supporting New Product Transitions, CIP (Continuous Improvement Projects) and Refurbished Systems for ALD. Working as a Technical Project Manager within ALD requires working in a team environment where the team members support each other. We value the ability to back up other team members. Be ready and willing to work with and help other Manufacturing Engineers, Test Techs, Quality Engineers, System Project Managers, Suppliers, Business Management, Operations Management, and Finance. ALD Products: ALD Business Unit is continuing to develop their ‘quad wafer’ chamber and Trillium products. For these products the NPT PM will work with Design Engineering, NPMEs, Materials PMs, Manufacturing Engineering, and Operations to develop high level POR (Plan for Record) which includes development of the manufacturing strategy including where and how modules will be built and tested. NPT PM manages manufacturing builds which start with lab chambers and ELS (Early Learning Shipment) builds through our ALD pilot line. NPT PM also manages the programs and builds as ALD Austin Manufacturing ships the DTOR (Development Tool of Record) shipments to customers. Along with the DTOR shipments, the NPT PM ensures that product is progressing with build and test documentation, supplier quality, and field quality. NPT PM finishes the new product transition to volume once the new product’s modules meet performance goals for capacity, cycle time, and quality. Functional Knowledge Demonstrates conceptual and practical expertise in Project Management and basic knowledge of Capital Equipment for Semiconductor Industry. Deeper knowledge of ALD tools is a plus Engineering Skill Requirements Requires knowledge and experience in own discipline; still acquiring higher-level knowledge and skills. Builds knowledge of the company, processes and customers. Solves a range of straightforward problems. Analyzes possible solutions using standard procedures. Receives a moderate level of guidance and direction. Requires ability to learn new skills and transpose them to solving manufacturing problems. Key Responsibilities Interfaces with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and/or new products. Launches, releases, approves and implements or issues engineering change requests as required to support design engineering and Operations with new and existing products. Estimates manufacturing costs, determines time standards and makes recommendations for tooling and process requirements. Uses DFx principles to reduce manufacturing and/or product costs, and improve delivered product quality. Lead team members to develop Build/Test specifications and documentation with a cross functional team. Works with Central Test Engineering, Test Techs, and other Test Engineers on the design and development of test fixtures. May assist in the coordination of test fixture sourcing activities. Gathers operational and test data and evaluates results; may takes corrective/continuous improvement actions. Continuous Improvement Evaluates work methods, test procedures, and workcenter policies. Participates in the development and maintenance of new and existing business processes and test strategies in order to continuously improve performance and reduce manufacturing cycle time. Failure Analysis and Non-Conformance Corrective Action Works with Customer Experience team to determine root cause of internal and external non-conformances. Drives corrective action back into test strategy based on corrective actions. Works with Customer Experience, and Design Engineers of failure analysis and drive corrective actions into test process. New Product Transitions Supports new product transitions as key manufacturing engineering team member. Works with Design Engineers to convert their test specifications into tests. Develops test strategies to efficiently test chambers to required quality and cycle time goals. Determines tooling and test fixtures required for testing new chambers as they transition into volume manufacturing environment. Business Expertise Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work Leadership No direct supervisory responsibilities but provides guidance to the team Able to keep team focused on program goals and system delivery on time and with high quality standards Problem Solving Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents Impact Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies Interpersonal Skills Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations Years of experience may vary from 2-7 years depending on grade assigned at offer. The posted range may vary depending on what grade level is assigned at offer. Education: Bachelor's Degree preferred – relevant and related experience may be substituted. The NPI Technical Program Manager (TPM) is an individual contributor role in the Common Solutions Group (CSG) responsible for driving new products from design maturity through transfer to high-volume manufacturing. You will own the integrated program plan, milestones, dependencies, and risk management while leading cross-functional partners across engineering, operations, materials, and manufacturing engineering. Success in this role requires strong communication, structured problem-solving, and the ability to remove roadblocks, drive decisions, and keep the team aligned to quality, time-to-market, and cost objectives. Applied Materials is the world leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. This NPI TPM position is in the Common Solutions Group (CSG) which supports all business units. The TPM is a strategic facilitator and has both strategic and execution responsibilities within a matrix organization on multiple product lines. This is an IC role where a drive for excellence and a sense of urgency connects design and manufacturing. The TPM is the “air traffic controller” that leads a matrix team of New Product Manufacturing Engineers (NPMEs), Material Project Managers (MPMs) and NPI Operations to mature the product and transfer it into high volume manufacturing. By finding and fixing issues proactively, the TPM ensures the team and the product meets Quality/Functionality, Time to Market and Cost objectives. Critical skills for the role include capacity for complexity, agility, requirements gathering, critical thinking, stakeholder management, change management, risk management and excellent communication. Additional skills and experience for this job include Systems Thinking, Organizational Change Management, Business Process Management, Lean, resource capacity and capability planning, predictive (waterfall) and agile project management, tolerance of ambiguity, influencing without direct authority and influencing team engagement. Key Responsibilities Program plan development and ownership: Establish the strategy, plan, and schedule; define and track milestones; break down deliverables and assign owners; map dependencies; identify and respond to changes and risks. Program stakeholder management: Align scope and requirements, drive weekly/biweekly cross-functional cadence, exec reviews, decision logs, and drive escalations to closure. Program execution: Remove roadblocks and drive completion to the plan. Adapt to changes. Assess readiness for transition to High Volume Manufacturing and enable the transfer of responsibilities. Forecast capacity and integration into manufacturing strategy. Organizational growth: Conduct lessons learned and integrate into business process improvements. The primary role for this Technical Project Manager is supporting ALD New Product Transitions, but responsibilities can flex into supporting New Product Transitions, CIP (Continuous Improvement Projects) and Refurbished Systems for ALD. Working as a Technical Project Manager within ALD requires working in a team environment where the team members support each other. We value the ability to back up other team members. Be ready and willing to work with and help other Manufacturing Engineers, Test Techs, Quality Engineers, System Project Managers, Suppliers, Business Management, Operations Management, and Finance. ALD Products: ALD Business Unit is continuing to develop their ‘quad wafer’ chamber and Trillium products. NPT PM also manages the programs and builds as ALD Austin Manufacturing ships the DTOR (Development Tool of Record) shipments to customers. NPT PM finishes the new product transition to volume once the new product’s modules meet performance goals for capacity, cycle time, and quality. Builds knowledge of the company, processes and customers. Solves a range of straightforward problems. Analyzes possible solutions using standard procedures. Receives a moderate level of guidance and direction. Requires ability to learn new skills and transpose them to solving manufacturing problems. Key Responsibilities: Interfaces with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and/or new products. Launches, releases, approves and implements or issues engineering change requests as required to support design engineering and Operations with new and existing products. Reporting to the Global Logistics Audit Program Manager, Global Logistics Sourcing, this position will support logistics audit and payment activities, reporting, process documentation, and analytical initiatives. The successful candidate will work closely with experienced logistics professionals while developing practical knowledge of logistics operations, business processes, systems, and performance management. Collaborate with carriers to improve billing quality and adherence to contracted terms. Support system enhancements testing and process standardization initiatives. Maintain audit trails and documentation for compliance and audits. Applied Materials is seeking an experienced Supply Chain Project Manager. The role will be at the Austin office and is onsite (not remote or hybrid). Role Overview As a key member of the Global Supply Chain Strategy Office, you will manage projects that protect continuity of supply as Applied accelerated material innovations. Working within the Transitions and Compliance team, you will run assigned continuity projects — supplier moves, dual-sourcing, supplier exits, and integration activity — from intake through closure: building the cross-functional team, maintaining the plan, and driving deliverables and risks to resolution. This role suits a proactive, organized supply chain professional who manages detail well, communicates clearly, and carries commitments to closure across a matrixed global organization. Strong supply chain, procurement or sourcing experience. Project management experience delivering through cross-functional teams. Significant data analysis/reporting skills. Key Responsibilities Project Management: Manage multiple supply chain continuity projects simultaneously, from intake and scoping through execution and closure — defining outcomes, milestones and resource needs, and delivering to plan. Supplier Transitions: Manage assigned supplier transitions — site moves, dual-sourcing, supplier exits and integration activity — ensuring complete part lists are captured, qualification and audit activity is scheduled, and supply is protected throughout. Change Management: Manage supplier change notifications for assigned continuity projects — confirming incoming changes are accurate and complete, resolving conflicts, and routing and expediting approvals to meet Applied change management requirements. SNF Administration: Support the SNF program team with day-to-day administration of the Supplier Notification Form process — reviewing incoming supplier submissions for completeness, routing them to the correct approvers, and following up on aging tasks. Material Movement: Plan and track the movement of material between suppliers, Applied sites and qualification locations — coordinating shipments, documentation and delivery commitments so material arrives when the project plan requires it. Collaboration & Communication: Build and maintain strong working relationships across Global Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, the Business Units and supplier contacts. Convene working meetings, document decisions, hold owners to their commitments, and provide clear and timely status to stakeholders at all levels. Risk & Issue Management: Identify risk early, confirm ownership with the responsible functions, track dependencies and open decisions, and escalate through established channels to limit downstream delay. Analytics & Reporting: Pull and validate part, supplier and project data, analyze, and develop the reporting used to track material status and risk reporting that drives decisions. Continuous Improvement & Documentation: Ensure all phases of project, program and process development are documented and disseminated to the relevant functional areas, and contribute improvements to team templates, playbooks and standards. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related field. 4–7 years of experience in supply chain, procurement, sourcing, project management, or analytics within a matrixed or global organization. Professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CAPM, Six Sigma) are a plus. Proficiency in Excel (formulas, pivot tables) and PowerPoint (presentation design). Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to influence and build relationships across diverse teams and geographies. Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, and stakeholder management abilities. Experience with supplier changes, transitions, or part qualification activity is an advantage but not required. Impact Statement This role is pivotal in protecting continuity of supply as Applied’s supply base evolves. The projects you deliver keep material flowing and factories building.
